Forward, midship ve aft draft'lar her ik: Forward, midship and aft drafts are read on both sides (six readings); in a seaway the wave effect is removed by averaging. The hog/sag correction (quarter mean / mean of means) is applied.
Net yük = (final displacement − ballast: Net cargo = final displacement − ballast − fuel − fresh water − constant. All tanks are sounded carefully; the constant must be consistent with previous surveys. The density correction is applied.
Kapaklar hidrolik/wire ile maker prosedü: Hatch covers are opened and closed hydraulically or by wire, following the maker's procedure; cleats, rubber packing and drainage are checked. On closing, all cleats are secured.
Hasarlı conta veya compression bar su gi: Damaged rubber packing or a damaged compression bar lets water in; rain or seas then wet the cargo (hygienic cargoes and grain are badly damaged).
Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting; where required, the combination ladder is set at the correct angle. The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.
Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen t: A wrongly rigged ladder can kill; every component is checked one by one.
Tug sayısı/pozisyon, yaklaşma açısı ve m: The number and positions of the tugs, the approach angle and the order of the mooring lines are planned; snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.
Derinlik, dip cinsi ve trafiğe göre yer: The anchorage position is chosen according to depth, nature of the bottom and traffic; a scope of typically 5–7 times the depth is planned. Brought up is confirmed; dragging is monitored with an anchor watch.
Uzun beklemelerde hava değişiminde sürük: During long waits the risk of dragging increases when the weather changes; monitoring is not relaxed.
Line tipleri sırayla verilir; halat kond: The lines are sent out in order; line condition, SWL and the balance of tensions are checked. No one stands in snap-back zones.
Kopan halat snap-back yapar; eğitim ve f: A parting line snaps back; training and awareness prevent fatal accidents.
Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ve seyir e: Certificates must be valid, and LSA, FFA and navigation equipment must be in working order. Findings from previous PSC and internal inspections are closed out with evidence. Areas specific to bulk carriers (hatch covers, holds) are in focus.
Detention gemiyi durdurur; hazırlık titi: A detention stops the ship; preparation must be thorough and evidence-based.
Hasar fotoğraflanır, konum/zaman kaydedi: Damage is photographed, its position and time are recorded and a Letter of Protest is issued. The condition is documented by clausing the mate's receipt; the source of wetting (rain, hatch leakage, sweat) is identified.
Cargo sweat/ship sweat kaynaklı ıslanmad: Where wetting is caused by cargo sweat or ship sweat, the ventilation records are important for the defence.
Kâğıt haritalar standart yöntemle tashih: Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a correction log is kept.
Tüm seyir/operasyon olayları, tatbikatla: All navigation and operational events, drills and checks are entered on time; statutory entries must be complete and signed.
Hava tahmini ve dalga durumu izlenir; ağ: The weather forecast and sea state are monitored; speed and course are adjusted in heavy weather. With Group A cargoes (which may liquefy), moisture and cargo behaviour are monitored and the route is changed if necessary.
Bulk Jupiter vakası, liquefaction'ın gem: The Bulk Jupiter casualty showed that liquefaction can capsize a ship.
Grab/vinç tel halat, fren ve hidrolik ba: Grab and crane wire ropes, brakes and hydraulics are maintained according to the PMS; hatch cover hydraulic cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks.
Vinç arızası geared gemide yük operasyon: On a geared ship a crane failure stops cargo operations and causes demurrage.
Yük grup (A/B/C), stowage factor ve dens: The cargo is distributed according to its group (A/B/C), stowage factor and density; the loading sequence is planned within the limits approved in the loading manual. In alternate hold loading the shear force can reach a critical point.
Her yükleme adımı loadicator'da SF/BM ve: Every loading step is checked in the loading computer for SF/BM and GM; values above 85% of the permissible limits are a sign that the plan needs revising. The printouts are kept.
Sürekli look-out yapılır; çatışma riski: A continuous lookout is kept; risk of collision is assessed by radar/ARPA and visually. Action is taken early and is substantial; on a large ship the effect of a manoeuvre comes late.
Büyük bulk gemisinin durma mesafesi uzun: A large bulk carrier has a long stopping distance; decisions must be taken early.
Yangın/MOB/abandon ship ve enclosed spac: Fire, man overboard, abandon ship and enclosed space entry and rescue drills are held; the muster list is kept up to date. Shortcomings are corrected through a debrief.
Bulk gemilerinde kapalı alan ölümleri ya: Deaths in enclosed spaces are common on bulk carriers; enclosed space drills are never neglected.
DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S: DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically (battery and HRU expiry dates). The accuracy of the AIS static and dynamic data is checked.
Pre-arrival/departure checklist (steerin: The pre-arrival and pre-departure checklists (steering gear test, ECDIS, equipment, reports) are completed; NAVTEX and port notices are followed.
Ölçümler trim ve density ile düzeltilir;: The readings are corrected for trim and density, and the net cargo is calculated by draft survey. The ship's figure is compared with the shore figure; if the difference exceeds the tolerance, a Letter of Protest is issued.
Group B yüklerde sıcaklık izleme, hold v: With Group B cargoes, temperature monitoring, hold ventilation (on or off as the cargo schedule requires), gas detection and control of ignition sources are applied. Ammonium nitrate-based cargoes need special precautions against fire and explosion.
Her yükün IMSBC schedule'ı bağlayıcıdır;: The IMSBC Code schedule of each cargo is binding; its ventilation and monitoring instructions are followed to the letter.
Rat guard halatlara takılır; yemleme ist: Rat guards are fitted on the lines; bait stations and hygiene measures are in place. The Ship Sanitation Certificate is kept valid.
Zararlı bulgusu gıda yüklerinde reddedil: A pest finding can lead to the rejection of a food cargo and to quarantine.
OOW sürekli look-out yapar; radar/ARPA i: The OOW keeps a continuous lookout, assesses risk with radar/ARPA and applies COLREG. Rest hours and a clear handover are ensured; when in doubt, the Master is called.
Yük dağılımı sagging/hogging dengesini b: The cargo distribution determines the balance between sagging and hogging; with high-density cargoes such as ore, the tank top load density limits are also checked.
Aşırı lokal yük yoğunluğu çift dip yapıs: Excessive local load density can damage the double-bottom structure.
Slack hold'larda tahıl yüzeyi kayarak he: In slack holds the grain surface shifts and produces a heeling moment; this moment is compared with the grain stability criteria (area under the GZ curve, angle of heel). Trimming and securing reduce the shift.
Hesap, onaylı grain loading booklet ile: The calculation is made with the approved grain loading booklet; some ports require an NCB inspection. Grain is not loaded unless the criteria are met.
Hose test su jeti ile sızıntı arar (yük: The hose test looks for leaks with a water jet (risky with cargo on board); the chalk test shows the contact of the rubber packing; the ultrasonic test measures leaks with the hold closed, using the PFU value. The results are documented.
Hassas yüklerde yükleme öncesi ultrasoni: For sensitive cargoes, an ultrasonic test before loading is the safest evidence against wet-damage claims.
Temizlik; sweeping, washing (deniz + tat: Hold cleaning covers sweeping, washing (seawater, then a fresh-water rinse), drying, removing odours, cleaning the bilge wells and touching up paint. The standard required depends on the charter party and the next cargo.
Hold inspection bizzat yapılır ve foto/v: The hold inspection is done in person and documented with photos or video; for grain, acceptance by the NCB or the surveyor is obtained. A rejected hold is cleaned again.
Fumigasyon lisanslı fumigator tarafından: Fumigation is planned by a licensed fumigator; gas levels are monitored in the accommodation and adjacent spaces. Leak checks are made and warning signs are posted.
Fosfin hem öldürücü hem patlayıcıdır; at: Phosphine is both lethal and explosive; it is kept away from ignition sources and no one enters the hold without a gas measurement. Entry before ventilation and gas-freeing is prohibited.
Loading sequence ve ballast planı BLU Co: The loading sequence and ballast plan are prepared in line with the BLU Code; the loading rate must match the deballasting capacity. Otherwise the SF/BM limits are exceeded or the operation is delayed.
Hızlı yüklemede ballast yetişemezse muka: If deballasting cannot keep up with fast loading, the strength limits can quickly be exceeded.
ENC güncellenir; safety contour/depth de: The ENCs are updated; the safety contour and safety depth are set from the deep draft plus the UKC margin. As the UKC margin of a ship loaded with ore can be small, the tidal window is planned.
Piston/liner/yatak/fuel injection runnin: Pistons, liners, bearings and fuel injection equipment are overhauled according to running hours; clearance measurements are recorded. Cleaning and balancing the turbocharger maintains performance.
Aşırı ısınan yatak oil mist üretir; dete: An overheated bearing produces oil mist; the oil mist detector and the crankcase relief valves protect against an explosion. After an oil mist alarm, the crankcase is not opened until it has cooled down.
Paralele alırken frekans/voltaj/faz eşit: When paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched; the load sharing must be balanced. The blackout recovery test is carried out.
Yanlış faz şaft/kuplaj kırabilir; insula: Paralleling out of phase can break the shaft or the coupling; the insulation resistance is measured.
Operasyonlar doğru kodla, zamanında işle: Operations are entered on time with the correct code; every page is signed by the Master. The entries must agree with what actually happened.
Nitrit/pH/kloride haftalık test edilir;: Nitrite, pH and chloride are tested weekly; the inhibitor dosage is maintained. Cleaning the coolers keeps the heat transfer efficient.
Disc'ler çalışma saatine göre temizlenir: The discs are cleaned according to running hours; the correct gravity disc is selected; the filter ΔP is monitored.
Sıcak HFO sıçraması yanık yapar; izolasy: Hot HFO splashes cause burns; lagging and PPE are provided.
Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic inspection. The risk of oil carry-over is monitored.
Yetersiz starting air manevrada ana maki: Insufficient starting air means a risk of being unable to start the main engine during manoeuvring.
Departure öncesi (12 saat içinde) main s: The main steering gear is tested before departure (within 12 hours); the emergency steering is verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is monitored.
CO2/foam yıllık/5 yıllık testlere tabidi: CO2 and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release, the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
CO2 boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız: CO2 can suffocate; it is released only after evacuation and a head count, under the lock-out procedure.
Günlük blow-down ve su kimyası testleri: Daily blow-down and boiler water chemistry tests are carried out; soot blowing prevents soot build-up. The safety valves are tested annually.
Kurum birikimi soot fire riski yaratır;: Soot build-up creates a risk of a soot fire; soot blowing is done regularly.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; kritik e: A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment has priority; job records are kept complete.
Yakıt/mesafe ile yıllık CII hesaplanır (: The annual CII (A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimisation, hull and propeller cleaning).
D/E rating düzeltici eylem planı gerekti: A D or E rating requires a corrective action plan.
Sensörler kalibre edilir; alarm noktalar: Sensors are calibrated; alarm points and the dead-man alarm are tested. In UMS mode the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins is verified.
Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar gerçek alarmı: Repeated false alarms lead to a real alarm being missed; the root cause is eliminated.
Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug: A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is controlled by hand. The tank ullages are monitored.
Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is checked and entered in the record book. The sulphur content must suit the area where the fuel will be used.
Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; limand: Salinity is monitored with the salinometer; production is stopped in port and near the coast because of contamination. The water is disinfected.
OCM 15 ppm'i aşarsa 3-way valve geri yol: If the OCM reading exceeds 15 ppm, the three-way valve returns the water to the bilge; discharge takes place only with the ship en route and when the MARPOL conditions are met (it is prohibited in the Antarctic area). Entries are made in ORB Part I with the correct code.
OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur: Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offence with heavy penalties; the records must agree with what actually happened.
Seal/bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; kapas: Seals and bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified with a capacity test. A high deballasting capacity is needed for the BLU sequence.
Yetersiz ballast kapasitesi hızlı yüklem: Insufficient ballast pump capacity can lead to SF/BM limits being exceeded during fast loading.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV doz izleni: After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB. With high ballast flow rates the system capacity is critical.
Electrochlorination'da H2 birikimi venti: In electrochlorination systems, hydrogen that builds up without ventilation can explode; gas monitoring is critical.
Silindirler ve hortumlar sızıntı açısınd: Cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; the hydraulic oil is kept clean and a pressure test is carried out. Correct operation together with the compression bars and rubber packing is verified.
Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı yaralanma yapar: A pressurised hydraulic leak can cause injury; the pressure is released before maintenance.
Hidrolik silindir/pompa veya elektrik mo: Hydraulic cylinders and pumps, or electric motors and contactors, are maintained; wire ropes and brakes are inspected according to the PMS. The overload protection is verified.
Vinç arızası geared gemide yük operasyon: On a geared ship a crane failure stops cargo operations.
Sludge sounding alınır; bertaraf inciner: Sludge tank soundings are taken; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to shore reception facilities. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.
ENC kataloğu S-63 lisansına göre güncell: The ENC catalogue is updated under the S-63 licence (including the AIO and T&P notices). The safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set from the ship's draft plus the UKC margin; these values directly determine how the ECDIS highlights dangers.
Route planner ile waypoint'ler girilir;: Waypoints are entered with the route planner; the check route function produces warnings for no-go areas, shoals and prohibited areas. Each warning is assessed one by one; an automatically generated route is never approved without a manual check.
Back-up ECDIS'e ENC ve route senkronize: The ENCs and the route are synchronised to the back-up ECDIS, and check route is run again with the same safety settings. It is verified that the GPS, gyro and log inputs show correctly on both units.
Mevcut haritalar, sailing directions, ti: The charts, sailing directions, tide and current data, weather and port information are collected; alternative routes and risky passages (TSS, narrow channels) are identified.
Waypoint, course, hız ve wheel-over nokt: Waypoints, courses, speeds and wheel-over points are defined; abort and contingency points are marked. XTD and UKC are monitored continuously during the passage.
Demir yeri derinlik, dip cinsi, akıntı v: The anchorage position is chosen according to depth, nature of the bottom, current and traffic; the scope is typically planned as 5–7 times the depth in chain. Brought up is confirmed.
Anchor watch ile sürüklenme (dragging) i: Dragging is monitored with an anchor watch (GPS and bearings); the engine is kept ready if necessary. When heaving up the anchor, the windlass load and the condition of the chain are watched.
Head/stern line, breast line ve spring l: Head and stern lines, breast lines and spring lines restrain the ship's fore-and-aft and sideways movement; they are sent out in the order of the pilot's and Master's plan. The condition of the lines and their MBL/SWL are checked.
Kopan halat snap-back yapar; personel sn: A parting line snaps back; no one stands in a snap-back zone. Mixed moorings (lines of different materials) add risk.
Tüm sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ekipma: All certificates must be valid, and the LSA and FFA equipment, ECDIS, GMDSS and safety equipment must be in working order. Previous PSC deficiencies must have been closed out with evidence.
ISM uygulama eksikleri, LSA/FFA kondisyo: Gaps in ISM implementation, the condition of LSA and FFA, and ECDIS and navigation records are frequent findings; they are corrected beforehand through internal audits.
Planlı iç denetimlerde uygunsuzluklar te: Non-conformities are identified in planned internal audits and closed out with a root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA). The records must be traceable.
Near-miss ve hazard raporlama teşvik edi: Near-miss and hazard reporting is encouraged; the data is used to improve the system.
Windlass brake holding test (rendering t: The windlass brake holding test (rendering test), hydraulic oil checks and greasing are carried out according to the PMS; the condition of the wire ropes is inspected.
Windlass freninin tutmaması demir operas: If the windlass brake does not hold, control of the anchor is lost and damage results.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; LSA/FFA: A monthly overdue report is produced; maintenance of critical safety equipment such as LSA and FFA has priority. Job records are kept complete.
Kritik güvenlik ekipmanı overdue'su hem: Overdue maintenance on critical safety equipment is both an ISM non-conformity and a risk to life.
Yük dağılımı sagging/hogging dengesini b: The cargo distribution determines the balance between sagging and hogging; on container ships torsion is also critical because of the open deck structure. At every step the loading computer verifies that the values stay below 100% of the limits.
MOL Comfort vakası, mukavemet limitlerin: The MOL Comfort casualty showed that ignoring strength limits can lead to the loss of the ship.
Belirli dalga periyodu/karşılaşma açısı: Certain combinations of wave period and encounter angle trigger parametric rolling; this resonance is avoided by changing course or speed. Weather routing advice is taken into account.
Ağır havaya girmeden önce rota/hız karar: The decision on course and speed is made before entering heavy weather; late action leads to the loss of containers.
Yorgunluk yönetimi (rest hours) ve net v: Fatigue is managed (rest hours) and a clear handover of the watch is made; when in doubt, the Master is called.
Kâğıt haritalar standart yöntemle tashih: Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a chart correction log is kept.
Chart correction log, güncelliğin kanıtı: The chart correction log is the proof that the charts are up to date and may be asked for by PSC.
Ağır konteynerlerin alt tier'lara, hafif: It is verified that heavy containers are in the lower tiers and light ones on top; the weights declared through the VGM (Verified Gross Mass) are reflected in the plan. Reefer plug positions, IMDG segregation and OOG positions are checked.
Plan stowage yazılımına yüklenir; GM, SF: The plan is loaded into the stowage software and the GM, SF/BM, torsion and list are checked. If a limit is exceeded, the plan is revised and sent to the terminal after the Chief Officer has approved it.
VHF/MF/HF DSC günlük/haftalık test edili: VHF/MF/HF DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically (the EPIRB battery and HRU expiry dates are followed). The accuracy of the AIS static and dynamic data is checked.
Yanlış AIS verisi (örn. yanlış draft/des: Wrong AIS data (for example a wrong draft or destination) causes both navigational and legal problems.
Halatlar aşınma, kesik ve UV hasarı açıs: Lines are inspected for wear, cuts and UV damage; retirement criteria are followed through the line management plan. Tails and fenders are checked.
Zayıflamış halat mooring sırasında kopab: A weakened line can part during mooring; regular inspection reduces the snap-back risk.
Tanklar günlük sounding edilir; beklenme: Tanks are sounded daily; an unexpected change in level points to a leak or a transfer error. The results are recorded in the log.
Düzenli sounding, sızıntı ve transfer ha: Regular soundings allow leaks and transfer errors to be detected early.
Hasar fotoğraflanır, konum/zaman kaydedi: Damage is photographed, its position and time are recorded and a Letter of Protest is issued to the party concerned. The condition is documented through the mate's receipt and clausing.
Belgelenmeyen hasar, sonradan gemiye yük: Undocumented damage leaves the ship defenceless against claims made against it later.
NOA ve gerekli liman bildirimleri zamanı: The NOA and other required port reports are made on time; the pre-arrival checklist (equipment tests, ECDIS, steering gear test) is completed. NAVTEX navigational warnings are followed.
Yangın, MOB ve abandon ship senaryoları: Fire, man overboard and abandon ship drills are held at the required intervals; lifeboats and davits, immersion suits and muster procedures are practised. Shortcomings are corrected through a debrief.
Konteyner gemilerinde DG kaynaklı yangın: On container ships, fire scenarios involving dangerous goods should also be included in the drills.
Her acil durum görevi (yangın ekibi, fil: Every emergency duty (fire team, lifeboat, first aid) and muster station is assigned; at a crew change the muster list is updated and posted. Familiarisation is carried out.
Tüm seyir/operasyon olayları, tatbikatla: All navigation and operational events, drills and safety checks are entered on time; the Official Log Book contains the statutory entries (drills, inspections and so on).
Tutarlı ve eksiksiz log, bir sorun çıktı: A consistent and complete log is the strongest defence when a problem arises.
Twist lock + lashing rod + turnbuckle ko: The combination of twistlocks, lashing rods and turnbuckles is applied according to the pattern in the CSM; tier limits, stowage on hatch covers and the positions of heavy and reefer containers are checked. Lashing tightness is verified physically.
Ağır yalpa (parametric rolling) lashing: If heavy rolling (parametric rolling) exceeds the lashing forces, the stacks collapse. Weather routing and lashing tightness are managed together.
DG manifest, packing certificate ve stow: The DG manifest, packing certificates and stowage positions are checked; incompatible classes are kept apart according to the segregation table. The EmS (emergency response) information must be ready.
Yanlış beyan edilmiş DG (örn. kalsiyum h: Wrongly declared dangerous goods (for example calcium hypochlorite) can cause a fire; CINS circulars and the indicators of suspicious cargo are followed.
Her reefer'ın set-point'i shipper talima: The set point of every reefer is verified against the shipper's instructions; the supply air temperature is the control variable. A reefer log is kept daily (usually twice a day); alarms are investigated at once.
Alarm veren reefer hızlıca incelenir (pl: A reefer in alarm is investigated quickly (plug, defrost, compressor); if it cannot be resolved, the engine team and the company are informed and the event is documented.
OOG yükler genelde flat-rack/platform üz: OOG cargo is usually carried on flat racks or platforms; it is planned with additional lashings (chain or web), lashing angles and an MSL calculation. The overhanging dimensions affect the use of neighbouring slots.
Ağır/büyük OOG için lashing planı mühend: For heavy or large OOG cargo, the lashing plan is applied on the basis of an engineering calculation and with the approval of the Chief Officer and the Master.
GM, IS Code minimumunun üzerinde ama par: GM is kept above the IS Code minimum but within the optimum range that does not trigger parametric rolling. A very high GM strains the lashings through violent, short-period rolling.
Her yükleme adımında SF/BM ve torsion %1: At every loading step SF/BM and torsion are kept below 100% of the limits; above 85% is the alarm band and the sequence is revised.
Yüksek fribordda accommodation ladder +: With a high freeboard, a combination of accommodation ladder and pilot ladder is rigged; the transfer point, the angle and the trapdoor arrangement are verified. A manrope, lifebuoy, lighting and a heaving line are ready.
Kurulum sorumlu zabit gözetiminde checkl: The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer; a crew member meets the pilot.
Tug sayısı/pozisyonu, yaklaşma açısı, rü: The number and positions of the tugs, the approach angle, the effect of wind and current and the mooring order are agreed with the pilot. The large windage area of a container ship is critical in wind.
Pruva/kıç istasyonları ile net haberleşm: Clear communication is established with the forward and aft stations; line tensions and snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.
Standby öncesi makine ısıtılır, yakıt (g: Before standby the engine is warmed up, the fuel is changed over (to MGO if necessary), the air receivers are full and the speed limits are set. The telegraph test and bridge–engine room communication are verified.
Manevra boyunca emirler tekrar edilerek: During manoeuvring orders are repeated back before they are carried out; the bell book is kept. Continuous running in the barred speed range is avoided.
Reefer sayısına göre devreye alınan DG s: The number of generators on line is adjusted to the number of reefers; when paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched. The power management system (PMS) handles standby starts and load sharing.
Black-out recovery testi yapılır; DG'ler: The blackout recovery test is carried out; the generators are overhauled according to running hours. Insulation and preferential tripping are verified.
Bilge high-level alarmları periyodik fon: Bilge high-level alarms are subject to periodic function tests; the OCM 15 ppm alarm is calibrated and the response of the three-way valve is verified.
Çalışmayan 15 ppm alarmı hem MARPOL ihla: A 15 ppm alarm that does not work is both a MARPOL violation and an inspection finding.
Sludge sounding düzenli alınır; bertaraf: Sludge tank soundings are taken regularly; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to shore reception facilities. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.
Incinerator flame failure trip arızalıys: If the incinerator flame failure trip is faulty, unburnt fuel can accumulate and explode.
Yağlamalı tipte header tank seviyesi ve: On oil-lubricated stern tubes, the header tank level and the bearing temperature are monitored; a falling level points to a leak at the outboard seal. The use of an EAL (environmentally acceptable lubricant) is mandatory in some areas.
Stern tube yağ kaçağı görünür deniz kirl: An oil leak from the stern tube causes visible pollution of the sea and must be reported.
Transfer öncesi valf line-up doğrulanır;: Before a transfer the valve line-up is verified; tank levels and overflow alarms are monitored. Large transfers are coordinated with the deck because of trim and list.
İçerideki transfer dahi yanlış valfle ta: Even an internal transfer can overflow a tank through a wrong valve; the line-up check is never skipped.
Wash water pH/PAH/türbidite monitör edil: The pH, PAH and turbidity of the wash water are monitored; in areas where open-loop operation is restricted, the ship changes over to closed-loop mode or to compliant fuel. The EGC Record Book is kept.
Scrubber arızasında kısa sürede uyumlu y: A plan for changing over to compliant fuel at short notice must be ready in case the scrubber fails.
Yakıt tüketimi ve kat edilen mesafe ile: The annual CII (rating A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance travelled; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimisation, hull cleaning and so on).
D/E rating düzeltici eylem planı gerekti: A D or E rating requires a corrective action plan; efficiency is a matter of both regulation and cost.
CO₂/foam sistemi yıllık/5 yıllık testler: The CO₂ and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, fire dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO₂ release the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
CO₂ boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız: CO₂ can suffocate; it is released only after evacuation and a head count, under the lock-out procedure.
Limandan ayrılmadan önce (12 saat içinde: The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); the emergency steering and its communications are verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is monitored.
Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt altına enj: A pressurised hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the pressure is released before maintenance.

Soot blowing düzenli yapılır; düşük yükt: Soot blowing is done regularly; long periods at low load increase soot build-up. The water chemistry and circulation are maintained.
Soot fire, sirkülasyon kesilince hızla i: A soot fire can quickly turn into an iron fire if the circulation stops; temperature and circulation are monitored.
Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug: A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs, drip trays and the SOPEP equipment are ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is controlled by hand. The tank ullages are followed.
Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is checked and entered in the appropriate record book (ORB). The sulphur content must suit the area where the fuel will be used.
Düzenli rounds ile sızıntı, ısınma ve an: Leaks, overheating and abnormal noise or vibration are checked on regular rounds; in UMS mode the dead-man alarm and the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins must work. The handover is made clearly.
UMS moduna geçmeden önce tüm kritik alar: Before changing over to UMS mode, the transfer of all critical alarms is verified.
SOx uyumu BDN kükürt içeriği veya scrubb: SOx compliance is shown by the sulphur content in the BDN or by the scrubber wash water data; for NOx the engines are adjusted in accordance with their Technical File. In ECAs the stricter limits apply.
ECA'ya girişte uyumlu yakıta geçiş zaman: On entering an ECA the changeover to compliant fuel must be made on time and recorded.
Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; eşik a: Salinity is monitored with the salinometer; if the limit is exceeded, the dump valve operates. Production is stopped in port and coastal waters because of contamination.
İçme suyu için periyodik bakteriyolojik: Drinking water is tested periodically for bacteria.
OCM 15 ppm'i aşarsa 3-way valve sintiney: If the OCM reading exceeds 15 ppm, the three-way valve returns the bilge water to the tank; discharge takes place only with the ship en route and when the MARPOL conditions are met (it is prohibited in the Antarctic area). Entries are made in ORB Part I with the correct code.
OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur: Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offence with heavy penalties; the ORB Part I entries must agree with what actually happened.
Nitrit/pH/kloride haftalık test edilir;: Nitrite, pH and chloride are tested weekly; the inhibitor dosage is maintained. On cold-climate routes the antifreeze concentration is checked in the circuits concerned.
Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a risk of fire and explosion.
Purifier disc'leri çalışma saatine göre: The purifier discs are cleaned according to running hours; the gravity disc is selected for the fuel density. The filter ΔP is monitored and the automatic back-flushing is verified.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV dozu izlen: After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB.
Electrochlorination'da H2 birikimi venti: In electrochlorination systems, hydrogen that builds up without ventilation can explode; gas monitoring and venting are critical.
Plug ve soketler ısınma/oksitlenme açısı: Plugs and sockets are inspected for heating and oxidation (with a thermal camera if necessary); a loose connection creates a risk of arcing and fire. The load distribution is monitored.
Plug çalışmalarında uygun izolasyon/LOTO: Proper isolation and LOTO are applied when working on plugs; refrigerant leak detection is carried out.
OOW sürekli uygun gözcülük yapar; radar/: The OOW keeps a proper lookout at all times; risk of collision is assessed by radar/ARPA and by sight. Action is taken early and is substantial, in accordance with COLREG.
Görev; PSV ikmali, AHTS/anchor handling,: The task is clearly defined as PSV supply, AHTS/anchor handling, diving, ROV/survey, pipe or cable laying, drilling, offshore loading, walk-to-work or heavy lifting. Each type of task brings its own watch circle, combination of references and stop criteria.
Faaliyeti güvenle durdurma süresi (termi: The time needed to stop the activity safely (terminate time), the least risky escape direction and the thrust and power that must remain after the Worst Case Failure (WCF) are calculated. These three values directly determine the DP class and redundancy required.
Görev gereksinimi ile geminin gerçek tek: By assessing the task requirements together with the actual technical condition of the ship, the required DP equipment class, level of redundancy, number of personnel and combination of position references are agreed with the client.
Sonuçlar operasyon planı, task risk asse: The results are written into the operations plan, the task risk assessment and the ASOG inputs, so that the bridge team sees the accepted limits and the response plan before starting the task.
Familiarisation kaydı, planlama paketi v: The familiarisation record, the planning package and the task risk assessment are kept on file; these three are reviewed again whenever the task changes.
Class 1'de tek hata pozisyon kaybına yol: In Class 1 a single fault may lead to loss of position; in Class 2 the failure of a single active component must not lead to loss of position; in Class 3 the loss of a single compartment through fire or flooding is also tolerated. The task determines which class it needs through its own level of risk.
Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI): The Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI) is the most severe single failure accepted in the ship's design. The thrust and power capacity that the online equipment retains in this scenario is confirmed; if the actual configuration would produce a loss greater than the WCFDI, the task is not started.
Görev için gerekli sınıf sağlanamıyorsa: If the class required for the task cannot be provided, the work is not started. Task Appropriate Mode (TAM) may only be used through an approved, risk-based process and with a reduced operating envelope; it does not automatically make missing redundancy acceptable.
Devralan DPO sistemi anlayıp kabul ettik: The checklist is signed by both DPOs once the relieving DPO has understood and accepted the system.
Alarm tanınır; acknowledge etmeden önce: The alarm is recognised; before acknowledging, its source and time are read and the position and heading trend is checked. The ASOG status is declared and the Master, the ECR and the task control centres are informed on the designated channel.
Alarm, DP, PMS/VMS ve iletişim kayıtları: The alarm, DP, PMS/VMS and communication records are preserved; after the incident, authority to resume is obtained through the formal process.
Interface/bridging document ile prosedür: Differences in procedures and SMS are closed through an interface (bridging) document. Communication channels, call signs, alert words, the action on loss of communication and joint emergencies are agreed.
Kuvvetli tide ve eddy için hız-yön trend: In strong tides and eddies, the speed and direction trend, the thrust margin and reference deviations are monitored. In an area with a risk of solitons, radar and current indications and the possibility of a sudden surge are followed; as the environmental limit approaches, the task equipment is recovered safely.
Dive control ile green light, dalgıç/çan: Green light status, the state of the divers and the bell, the working depth and the recovery time are shared continuously with dive control. Any change of heading or position is reported to dive control in advance; the ship does not move without explicit agreement.
Yellow/Red durumda dalış çanı geri alma: In Yellow or Red status, recovery of the diving bell and the emergency rescue plan are started in accordance with the ASOG.
Move/heading change talepleri küçük artı: Move and heading change requests are carried out in small steps, with confirmation from ROV control at each step. On loss of telemetry, excessive umbilical tension or DP degradation, the recovery or abandon criteria are applied.
Final mevkide relative ve absolute refer: In the final position, relative and absolute references are compared; the environmental limits and the thrust margin are monitored in accordance with the ASOG. While a hose or crane load is connected, or personnel are on deck, no setpoint or heading change is made without permission.
Hava, güç, thruster, PRS veya hortum ger: If the limits for weather, power, thrusters, PRS or hose tension are exceeded, the transfer is stopped, the lines are disconnected and the ship moves to a safe distance.
Aşırı tension, stabilite limiti, power/t: In the event of excessive tension, a stability limit, power or thruster degradation, or loss of command, the emergency release or abort plan is applied.
S-lay'de joint boyuna uygun incremental: In S-lay, incremental moves match the joint length; in J-lay and reel-lay, approved low-speed auto-track is used. In the event of a welding or production delay, loss of tension, a DP excursion or the WCF, the hold, laydown or abandon procedure is started.
Rock dumping'de survey doğrulamasıyla ço: In rock dumping, a multi-pass plan is used with survey verification; in cable work, the catenary and the minimum bend radius are followed. If the vehicle snags, tension rises, telemetry is lost or DP degrades, the stop and recovery plan is applied.
CAMO, kritik faaliyette (dalış, ağır kal: CAMO imposes the most conservative configuration in order to keep full redundancy during critical activities (diving, heavy lifting, drilling). TAM allows operation with less equipment when the result of the WCF is acceptable for the task; but this is always based on an approved table and a risk-based decision.
Onaylı CAMO/TAM tablosundan güç üretimi,: The status of power generation, bus-ties, thrusters, PRS, sensors, UPS, cooling and auxiliary systems is taken from the approved CAMO/TAM table. Each item of equipment is lined up according to the table and cross-checked by an independent person.
Konfigürasyon değiştiğinde ASOG statüsü: When the configuration changes, the ASOG status and the result of the WCF are re-assessed. CAMO/TAM is not changed uncontrolled while the task is in progress; a change is made only through MOC and with authorised approval.
FSO/FPSO hareketi ve geminin coğrafi mev: The movement of the FSO/FPSO and the ship's geographic position are monitored together; the divergence alarm limits are verified. Alarms for drive-off/drift-off, hawser overload or loss of the relative PRS are matched with the ASOG actions.
Yellow/Red durumda transfer durdurulur;: In Yellow or Red status, the transfer is stopped; ESD/ERS and the disconnection sequence are carried out according to the approved terminal procedure.
Riser angle monitoring ile DP pozisyon t: Riser angle monitoring and the DP position trend are watched together; a relaxed position or heading is used only within the approved envelope. On the WCF, drive-off/drift-off or an environmental limit, the secure well, disconnect and escape route sequence is followed.
Transfer boyunca DPO, gangway operator v: Uninterrupted communication is kept between the DPO, the gangway operator and the installation control room throughout the transfer. As a limit is approached, no new crossings are started; in Yellow or Red status, or on a gangway trip, the planned disconnection and recovery are carried out.
Pick-up, slew, transfer ve landing safha: During the pick-up, slew, transfer and landing phases, the position, heading, thrust, list and hook load trends are monitored. The DPO is warned before a load is suddenly taken up or released; setpoint and gain changes are made only as planned.
DP, crane, rigging veya hava limiti aşıl: If a DP, crane, rigging or weather limit is exceeded, the load is moved to the designated safe position.
Test sonucunun CAMO, ASOG, consequence a: The effect of the test result on the CAMO, the ASOG, the consequence analysis and the emergency drills is assessed. After a modification or a recurring fault, the FMEA is updated as a living document.
DP loguna DP'ye giriş/çıkış zamanı, göre: The DP log records the times of entering and leaving DP, the task, position, heading, online equipment, PRS, environment, alarms and changes of status. Maintenance, bypass, defect, test and drill records are linked to the relevant technical file.
Sequence of events ile initiating event,: The sequence of events is used to separate the initiating event, hidden failures, human factors and barrier failures. Corrective and preventive actions are assigned with owners and deadlines; the FMEA, ASOG, procedures and training needs are updated.

Her arayüz ünitesi, bağlandığı iticinin,: Each interface unit can be placed near the thruster, reference system or sensor to which it is connected. The result is a marked reduction in cabling, which means lower cost in newbuilding and better feasibility in a retrofit.
MT, bu sağlam tasarımın özellikle servis: MT stresses that this robust design matters especially on ships where a service engineer and a system specialist are not available around the clock. Offshore, the maker's engineer is often hours or days away when a fault occurs; it is critical that the system can stay up on its own.
Arayüz ünitesinin tasarımı, Bridge Mate: The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernisation in all equipment classes. As the same hardware modules are used in the different classes, an upgrade to a higher class usually means more of the same hardware, not a new type of hardware.
Dağıtık mimari, arıza analizinde soruyu: A distributed architecture changes the question asked in fault analysis. Instead of "Which card has failed?", the question becomes "Which IO unit has dropped out and what was it feeding?". For this reason, the thruster, reference system, power supply and sensor group served by each IO unit must have been identified in advance.
JX ve DP 0 sistemleri, DP 1, DP 2 ve DP: The JX and DP 0 systems are based on the same distributed architecture as the DP 1, DP 2 and DP 3 systems. This arrangement allows the hardware components to be placed in practical locations: each interface unit (IO hardware) is placed near the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors to which it is connected, reducing cabling and installation costs.
Her iki sistem de \"compact operator sta: Both systems can be delivered as a "compact operator station" or a "console" version; the console version is available in several configurations to suit the need. The JX system can easily be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems.
Class 1 sistem mimarisi tümüyle dağıtık: The Class 1 system architecture is based entirely on a distributed concept. A DP 1 system has a single control computer, a single operator station and separate IO units interfacing the sensors, the position reference system, the power supply and the thrusters.
Bridge Mate DP sistemine bağımsız bir jo: An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This is operationally important because it provides a separate means of manoeuvring when the DP control path is lost.
DP 2 sistemi, DP 1 ile aynı modüllerden: A DP 2 system consists of the same modules as DP 1, but the number of modules is increased for redundancy in order to comply with the Class 2 rules. A DP 2 system uses three control computers and typically two operator stations.
Üç kontrol bilgisayarı kullanılması, bil: Using three control computers allows majority voting between the computers and the rejection of a computer that has failed. The number of IO units is typically much higher in DP 2: there is a separate IO unit for each sensor set, each position reference system, the power supply and each thruster.
Bu konfigürasyon, tek bir arızanın mevki: This configuration is used to provide redundancy at all levels, to ensure that a single failure does not result in loss of position. All modules are interconnected over a redundant dual network.
DP 3 sistemi, DP 2'ye kıyasla genişletil: A DP 3 system has an extended hardware configuration compared with DP 2. The triple-redundant DP controller is still used and at least three operator stations are required. Unlike the dual sensor sets typically used in a DP 2 configuration, there are three IO units for interfacing the components.
DP 3 sistemi ayrıca, Class 3 gereklerini: To meet the Class 3 requirements, a DP 3 system also needs a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment in which one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit must be installed.
DP 1'den DP 2'ye yükseltme kolay bir sür: Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is straightforward, because both types of system use the same hardware modules and only the number of units differs. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy.
Sınıf doğrulaması bir belge işlemi değil: Verifying the class is not a paperwork exercise but part of the decision to accept the task. If the ship does not meet the requirements of its declared class at that moment, the limitation is entered in the ASOG and the scope of the task is reduced accordingly. Manuel, joystick ve DP operasyonlarının: Manual, joystick and DP operations are all brought together at one point. DP 2 kurulumunda tipik olarak iki, DP 3': A DP 2 installation typically has two operator stations, and a DP 3 installation at least three. DP vardiya devir teslimi, gemi ve sistem: The DP watch handover covers the state of the ship and the system as well as the task and the environment. With Bridge Mate, the station configuration and the active profile are also handed over.
Dokunmatik ekran, fiziksel butona kıyasl: A touch screen carries a greater risk of a wrong touch than a physical button, especially when the ship is moving. For this reason, making critical mode changes with a confirmation step, and the operator reading the target value before executing the command, are part of good DP practice.
Multi-Function Workstation'da DP dışında: On a Multi-Function Workstation, it must be ensured that DP monitoring continues without interruption while applications other than DP are open. The screen brightness is set through central dimming to a level that does not spoil night vision; the alarm volume is not turned down.
Green normal operasyon; Advisory/Blue di: Green is normal operation; Advisory/Blue means caution and monitoring; Yellow means bringing the activity to a safe stage; Red means stopping or abandoning the activity. The colours are defined in the ship-specific ASOG, and no shift in their meaning between projects is allowed.
Bir limit aşıldığında ilgili renge geçil: When a limit is exceeded, the corresponding colour status is declared, the parties are informed and the written action is carried out. Even if conditions improve, the status is not stepped down without authorised approval and a renewed check.
RadaScan, dinamik konumlandırma ve diğer: RadaScan is an advanced position reference sensor that uses radar technology for dynamic positioning and other ship control applications. It works with high accuracy over a range of 10 m to 1000 m, complements GPS in close-range operations and can replace conventional laser systems.
CyScan, deniz aracı kontrol uygulamaları: CyScan is a high-performance local position reference sensor designed specifically for marine vessel control applications. It works as a primary or back-up sensor and is compatible with all Marine Technologies DP systems.
Genel DP uygulamasında her referans, DP: In general DP practice, each reference is observed independently and compared with the existing references before it is included in the DP model. Before a reference with a growing deviation is simply deselected, the cause is investigated, because the deviating sensor may sometimes be the correct one while the others share a common error.
Offshore tesise yaklaşımda DP genellikle: When approaching an offshore installation, DP is usually set up outside the zone and the system is allowed to stabilise; in the final approach phase a second independent reference is brought in. Local references such as RadaScan and CyScan are decisive at this stage for the accuracy of the position relative to the target.
Lokal referanslarda en sık görülen kayıp: The most common cause of losing a local reference is that the target can no longer be seen: shadowing of the reflector or transponder, the angle closing as the ship moves, or a structure or crane boom coming in between. With satellite-based references, ionospheric scintillation, jamming and spoofing can affect all satellite-based sources at the same time.
Her Multi-Function Workstation, dokunmat: Each Multi-Function Workstation consists of a touch screen and an operator computer that runs silently because it needs no fan. Klavye, baş seçici (heading selector) ve: Operator devices such as a keyboard, a heading selector and a joystick are available as appropriate for operating the system. Any workstation can be selected for any application at any time.

IBS ayrıca güç yönetim sistemi, otomasyo: The IBS can also be integrated with ship systems such as the power management system, automation, the alarm system, navigation lights and searchlights, the horn and the wipers.
Köprüüstü genelinde uyumlaştırılmış (har: A harmonised HMI throughout the bridge means that the same operation is carried out in the same way at every station. This is an important human-factors advantage that lowers the error rate at watch changes and under stress. Central dimming protects night vision from a single point.
Track control ve otomatik rota tutmadan: When changing over from track control and automatic course keeping to DP mode, the point at which control is transferred must be clearly defined. In general DP practice this changeover is made gradually, after the speed has been reduced sufficiently and the ship has become stable.
IBS'in alarm sistemiyle entegrasyonunda,: When the IBS is integrated with the alarm system, it must be verified that DP-related alarms are not suppressed on the bridge. Every suppressed or disabled alarm is recorded and passed on at the handover.
Bridge Mate DP sistemine bağımsız bir jo: An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This independence is operationally critical: when the DP control path is lost, the ability to manoeuvre with the joystick is preserved as a separate path.
Bridge Mate JX sistemi de aynı dağıtık m: The Bridge Mate JX system is also based on the same distributed architecture and can be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems.
Kademeli geçiş, her adımda geminin tepki: A gradual changeover makes it possible to observe the ship's response at each step and to verify it before moving on to the next. Changing over directly to fully automatic mode means that a faulty thruster response or a wrong reference is noticed only after the position has started to drift.
Genel DP uygulamasında, DP'ye geçmeden ö: In general DP practice, each thruster and main propeller is proved in both directions in manual control before changing over to DP. The command, the feedback and the physical response are compared; the system is not taken over until all three are verified to agree.
İticiler prove edildikten sonra kontrol: Once the thrusters have been proved, control is handed over gradually. First, automatic heading control is engaged in joystick mode and the ship's response is observed; position control is added once the behaviour is stable.
Tam otomatik mevki tutmaya geçildikten s: After changing over to fully automatic position keeping, time is allowed for stabilisation so that the DP mathematical model can learn the environmental forces. During this time the ship settles and the system builds up its estimate of the wind, current and wave forces.
Her mod geçişi; komuttaki istasyon, saat: Every mode change is entered in the DP log together with the station in command, the time and the type of change. Having a second person monitor the changeover breaks a one-person error chain.
Her geçişin bir geri dönüş yolu olmalıdı: Every changeover must have a way back. If unexpected behaviour is seen in DP, reverting to joystick or manual control must be a movement that has been thought through and practised in advance. Regular testing of the independent joystick path is therefore an operational requirement.
Proje, müşteri veya uzun bakım sonrası m: After a project, a new client or a long maintenance period, the mobilisation checklist is completed; the task equipment installed, PRS additions and software changes are recorded.
Pre-DP checklistte mevcut konfigürasyonu: The pre-DP checklist checks that the current configuration matches the CAMO/TAM and the ASOG. Permission to commence operations is not given without the approval of the Master and the Chief Engineer.
500 m bölgesine giriş için tesisten izin: Permission to enter the 500 m zone is obtained from the installation and the pre-entry checklist is completed. DP is set up and stabilised outside the zone; within the last 250 m a second independent reference is brought in.
Her thruster ve ana pervane manuel kontr: Each thruster and main propeller is proved in both directions in manual control; the command, the feedback and the physical response are compared. It is checked that the gyros, MRU/VRS, wind sensors and the selected PRS are healthy and correctly weighted.
Önce Auto Yaw ile baş stabilize edilir,: First the heading is stabilised with Auto Yaw, then the surge and sway axes are brought into Auto Position in a controlled way. The position setpoint is chosen close to the current position; no sudden large setpoint or heading change is given.
Model çevresel kuvvetleri öğrenene kadar: The ship is held steady long enough for the model to learn the environmental forces, and the actual performance is monitored. Work does not start until the capability plot, the consequence analysis and the footprint show the expected behaviour.
Görev ve su derinliğine göre DGNSS, HPR/: A combination of DGNSS, HPR/USBL, taut wire, laser, microwave or relative PRS is chosen to suit the task and the water depth. It is taken into account that two GNSS units using the same satellite or correction source may not be truly independent.
Yeni referans önce monitor konumunda göz: A new reference is first observed in the monitor position; if its residual, variance and trend are consistent, it is enabled in a controlled way. If a reference deviates, rather than deselecting it at once, common sensors, targets, geometry and environmental causes are compared.
Sensör fark alarmında hatalı kaynak tren: On a sensor difference alarm, the faulty source is diagnosed from the trend, the voting and independent observation. When a sensor is disabled, the consequence analysis and the ASOG status are checked again.
Footprint plot ile gerçek pozisyon-baş d: The footprint plot records the actual spread of position and heading, the thrust used and the environmental trend. If the field performance does not match the model, the limits are reduced, the cause is investigated and action is taken in accordance with the ASOG.
En büyük online jeneratör veya grup kayb: The spinning reserve, which assesses the frequency and the remaining capacity after the loss of the largest online generator or group, is followed. The standby generator is started and synchronised before the load trend reaches the limit, and the bridge is informed.
Blackout recovery sırası emergency gener: The ship-specific blackout recovery sequence is practised: emergency generator, essential auxiliaries, generator start, bus energisation and thruster connection. At each reconnection the frequency and voltage stability and the available power are checked; which thruster is brought in first is coordinated with the DPO according to the escape and drift directions.
Beklenmeyen etki hemen limitation/defect: An unexpected effect is reported at once as a limitation or defect and reflected in the CAMO and ASOG. After close-out the retest is evidenced; drawings, the software version and the FMEA revision are updated.
Uygulama sonrası alarm, controller switc: After the work, alarms, controller switchover, PRS and sensor inputs, thruster commands and the consequence analysis are tested. The version, parameters, test results and changed operating limits are documented and the team is given familiarisation.
Tekrarlayan defect ve overdue maintenanc: The effect of recurring defects and overdue maintenance on redundancy and on the ASOG is reported to the Master and the DPO. After maintenance, the return-to-service test and independent verification are completed.
