TCS motor markasından bağımsız çalışsa d: Although the TCS works independently of the engine make, the interface parameters are set separately for each unit. Pitch, rpm and azimuth scale factors, ramp times, barred angles and derating curves are determined and recorded during commissioning. These records are the reference point for every later change.
Backup thruster kontrolü ve bağımsız joy: The back-up thruster control and the independent joystick path must be separate from the main DP/TCS path. This separation is verified not only on the drawings but also at the level of the physical cable routes and power supplies.
Autopilot ve joystick entegrasyonunda ko: In the integration of the autopilot and joystick, the way command priority and the transfer of control are resolved must be compared with the FMEA. A configuration in which more than one source can give commands at the same time must be prevented by design.
İtici akıntısının gövdeye veya başka bir: When a thruster's wash strikes the hull or another thruster, the net thrust is reduced. The barred angles and interaction corrections defined in the TCS are needed for the DP to estimate correctly the thrust it will actually obtain. If these definitions are wrong, the capability plot is also misleading.
TCS üzerinde yapılacak her müdahale — pa: Any intervention on the TCS — a parameter change, a card replacement, a software update — directly affects the DP capability. Before the work, a joint assessment is made with the bridge, the redundancy group that will be affected is identified and, if necessary, the ASOG status is changed.
Dağıtık operatör istasyonları ve DP kont: In addition to the distributed operator stations and DP control computers, the Bridge Mate system includes distributed thruster and sensor interface units based on a stand-alone IO unit designed specifically for use on DP ships. Each interface unit can be placed near the thrusters, reference systems and sensors to be interfaced.
JX ve DP 0 sistemlerinde de aynı düzen g: The same arrangement applies to the JX and DP 0 systems: the IO hardware is placed near the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors it interfaces, reducing cabling and installation costs.
İki ağ kolunun fiziksel olarak ayrı güze: It must be verified that the two network branches run along physically separate routes and are not lost together in a single fire or flooding event. This is the basic check that shows whether dual network redundancy exists only on paper or also in the field.
Ağ switch'i, IP adresleme ve konfigürasy: Network switches, IP addressing and configuration changes must be kept under controlled change management. A switch replacement that looks minor can, without anyone noticing, make both branches dependent on a single device.
DP bilgisayarları, operatör istasyonları: Uninterrupted and mutually independent control power supplies must be verified for the DP computers, operator stations, position reference systems and sensors. In the Bridge Mate architecture, the power supply of each IO unit is taken from the single-line diagram and matched with the redundancy groups.
Kısmi veya tam blackout sırasında DP kon: Keeping the DP control layer up during a partial or total blackout is the precondition for a controlled recovery. If the control system loses power, the ship stays blind for as long as the system takes to restart once power returns, and the loss of position grows.
Arayüz ünitesinin tasarımı, Bridge Mate: The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernisation in all equipment classes. The compact design and distributed architecture keep the cabling work on existing ships limited.
Mevcut gemilerde MT, DP, köprüüstü enteg: On existing ships MT retrofits DP, integrated bridge and thruster control systems. A midlife upgrade typically involves replacing the control computers, operator stations, network switches and software, while the existing IO cabinets and cabling infrastructure are kept.
Bridge Mate JX sistemi DP 0'a kolayca yü: The Bridge Mate JX system can easily be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy. Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is also straightforward; both types of system use the same hardware modules and only the number of units differs.
DP 3 hedefleniyorsa iş yalnızca elektrik: If DP 3 is the aim, the work is not only electrical and automation work. To meet the Class 3 requirements, a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment is needed in which one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit will be installed. The layout changes for the third operator station and the third IO set must be engineered early.
Yükseltme sonrası FMEA revizyonu, provin: The chain of FMEA revision, proving trials and class survey after the upgrade must be planned before the work is finished. Hardware and software changes can invalidate the failure mode assumptions of the old FMEA; the revision is therefore not a formality but a technical re-assessment.
Yeni sistemin devreye alınması, ekibin o: Commissioning a new system does not mean that the team knows it. If the operator stations and HMI have changed, familiarisation training and a familiarisation record are needed for the DPOs; the engine side also needs to learn the new fault diagnosis flows.
Failed/slow start bulgusu ASOG statüsüne: A failed or slow start finding is reflected in the ASOG status and the standby order is updated. After the test, all selectors, breakers and alarm bypasses are returned to their operational positions.
Planlı switching için risk değerlendirme: For planned switching, a risk assessment is made, permission is obtained from the DPO and the Master, and the critical activity is stopped if possible. After switching, the PMS/DP mimic, load sharing, consequence analysis and alarm status are cross-checked.
Battery autonomy/capacity testi planlı p: The battery autonomy and capacity test is carried out under a planned procedure and weak cells are trended. After a bypass, two people verify that the system has returned to its normal redundant configuration.
Local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-z: The local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-zero and drive protection functions are returned from the test state to the operational position. A derated or unavailable thruster is correctly defined in the DP model and the capability plot and consequence analysis are updated.
DP'nin demanded ve delivered thrust değe: The demanded and delivered thrust values of the DP are trended; a low response despite a high command is investigated. Settings are not changed without MOC and the approval of the Master, the DPO and the Chief Engineer.
Duty/standby pump auto-start, low pressu: Duty/standby pump auto-start and the low pressure, high temperature and strainer differential alarms are tested. The effect of ventilation, fire dampers and machinery space flooding boundaries on the redundancy groups is checked.
İş sırasında yeni alarm veya konfigürasy: Any new alarm or configuration change during the work is reported to DP control at once. When the work is finished, a function test is carried out, all bypasses and isolations are removed and the consequence analysis is verified.
Failure mode FMEA ve IMCA M247 component: The failure mode is matched with the FMEA and the IMCA M247 component list, and the possibility of a common cause is investigated. Instead of a temporary reset, a safe configuration, the ASOG status and a permanent corrective action are decided.
Captain mode aracı, birden fazla kaptan: The Captain mode tool allows the personal preferences of several masters to be stored for specific phases such as transit, berthing and DP operations. Checking that the correct profile is loaded for the correct phase should be part of the watch routine.
Rampa hidrolik ile maker prosedürüne gör: The ramp is opened and closed hydraulically following the maker's procedure; on closing, all locking pins and cleats are engaged and the "secured/closed" status is verified on the indicator panel. The bow visor/door interlock system is checked.
Gemi rıhtımdan ayrılmadan rampa/bow door: Before the ship leaves the berth, it is verified both physically and on the indicators that the ramp and bow door are closed and locked; going to sea with a door open or partly closed creates a risk of water ingress and rapid capsizing.
Araçlar CSM'deki pattern'e göre en az 4: Vehicles are secured at a minimum of four points according to the pattern in the CSM; the MSL of the chains or webbing is chosen for the vehicle weight and the sea conditions. Wheel chocks are fitted and brakes applied.
Lashing gerginliği seyir sırasında kontr: Lashing tension is checked during the voyage; slack lashings are tightened again. Additional lashings are applied when heavy weather is expected.
Rampa, rıhtım link-span ile hizalanacak: The ship berths so that the ramp lines up with the shore link-span, using the bow thruster and, if necessary, tugs. Mooring safety is maintained even during quick turnarounds.
DG araçlar beyan edilir, segregation tab: Vehicles carrying dangerous goods are declared and stowed in compliance with the segregation table; ventilation, fire-fighting access and EmS readiness are ensured. Vehicle engines are switched off after stowage.
Kapalı araç güvertesinde DG yangını hızl: A dangerous goods fire spreads quickly on a closed vehicle deck; segregation and access are never neglected.
Araç yüksekliği güverte clearance ile, a: The vehicle height is compared with the deck clearance and the weight with the deck load density; a special lashing plan is made. If it is not suitable, the vehicle is not accepted.
Tek bir ağır aracın yanlış konumu lokal: Placing a single heavy vehicle in the wrong position can cause local deck damage.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; rampa/LS: A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment such as ramps, LSA and FFA has priority. Job records are kept complete.
Sertifikalar geçerli; rampa/kapı sızdırm: Certificates must be valid; the watertightness of the ramps and doors, LSA and FFA and the evacuation arrangements are checked. Previous findings are closed out.
Araç güvertesi yangını ve yolcu tahliyes: Vehicle deck fire and passenger evacuation scenarios are practised; use of the MES and lifeboats, mustering and passenger guidance procedures are drilled. A debrief is held.
Yolcu gemilerinde tahliye süresi (SOLAS): On passenger ships the evacuation time criteria (SOLAS) must be verified through drills.
Araç güvertesinde yaya-araç ayrımı, PPE: On the vehicle deck, separation of pedestrians and vehicles, PPE (hi-vis, hard hat), management of exhaust gas and CO, and lashing checks are applied with standard checklists.
Güverte/rampa aydınlatması ve acil aydın: Deck and ramp lighting and the emergency lighting (including low-location lighting) are tested; defective fittings are replaced.
DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S: DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically. The accuracy of the AIS data is checked.
Araç elleçleme sırasında ventilasyon tam: During vehicle handling the ventilation runs at full capacity and CO levels are monitored. On a closed deck, insufficient ventilation leads to a fatal build-up of CO.
Çalışan motorlar hızla CO biriktirir; ve: Running engines build up CO quickly; entering without ventilation is dangerous.
Ağır araçlar uygun güverteye/eksene yerl: Heavy vehicles are placed on the appropriate deck and along the right axis; the deck load density is not exceeded. Access and manoeuvring space are kept according to the order of the discharge ports. A vehicle tally is kept.
Yanlış yerleştirme hem stabiliteyi bozar: Wrong placement both impairs stability and delays discharge.
Tüm olaylar, tatbikatlar ve kontroller z: All events, drills and checks are entered on time; statutory entries are complete and signed.
Sürekli look-out yapılır; risk radar/ARP: A continuous lookout is kept; risk is assessed by radar/ARPA and by sight, and action is taken early and is substantial. On busy ferry routes, traffic separation is complied with.
Halatlar aşınma/kesik açısından denetlen: Lines are inspected for wear and cuts, and the condition of the fenders is checked. Because of the frequent operations, the retirement criteria are followed closely.
Acil durum görevleri ve istasyonlar atan: Emergency duties and stations are assigned; on passenger ships, passenger guidance and counting duties are added. They are updated at crew changes and familiarisation is carried out.
Araç güvertesine su girişi büyük serbest: Water entering the vehicle deck lowers GM quickly through a large free surface effect; the watertightness of doors and ramps is therefore part of stability. The loading condition must meet the intact and damage stability criteria.
Araç güvertesinde su birikmesi (water on: Water accumulating on the vehicle deck (water on deck) is the main cause of Ro-Ro capsizes; drainage and watertightness are managed together.
Fire door ve watertight door'ların kapan: Closing and locking of the fire doors and watertight doors is tested; the drencher/sprinkler system (vehicle deck) must be ready. Their status is monitored on the indicator panel.
Araç güvertesi yangını hızla yayılır; bö: A vehicle deck fire spreads quickly; subdivision and the drencher system are the critical defences.
Rubber seal/conta hasar açısından denetl: Rubber seals and packing are inspected for damage; the locks must close fully and give compression. The drainage and bilge alarm systems are tested.
Sızdıran rampa/kapı, araç güvertesine su: A leaking ramp or door lets water onto the vehicle deck and leads to a rapid loss of stability; watertightness is verified before going to sea.
ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri dr: The ENCs are updated and the safety settings are adjusted to the draft. On routes with a tight schedule, contingencies are defined for heavy traffic and narrow passages.
Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting, and checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.
Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen k: A wrongly rigged ladder can kill; every component is checked.
Trim, rampa eğimini araç geçişi için uyg: The trim is adjusted to keep the ramp slope suitable for vehicles; an excessive list upsets the balance of vehicles. This is checked with the loading computer; the BWTS is in operation (D-2).
Araç ağırlıkları, DG beyanları ve çıkış: Vehicle weights, dangerous goods declarations and discharge ports are entered in the manifest, and agreement with the actual cargo is verified. Vehicles carrying dangerous goods are also checked for segregation.
Silindir ve hortumlar sızıntı açısından: Cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; the full closing and opening sequence of the locking actuators is tested. The hydraulic oil is kept clean and a pressure test is carried out.
Rampa kilitleri tam kapanmazsa sızdırmaz: If the ramp locks do not close fully, watertightness and the safety of the ship are compromised; hydraulic maintenance is an integral part of door watertightness.
Pervane (CPP ise pitch kontrolü), yağlam: The propeller (pitch control if a CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the propulsion motor and its insulation and the controls are tested. A function test is run before manoeuvring.
Bow thruster arızası sık manevra yapan f: On a ferry that manoeuvres frequently, a bow thruster failure makes berthing much harder.
Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic inspection.
Sık manevrada yetersiz starting air ana: With frequent manoeuvring, insufficient starting air means a risk of being unable to start the main engine.
CO2 boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız: CO2 can suffocate; it is released only after evacuation and a head count.
Yakıt/mesafe ile yıllık CII hesaplanır (: The annual CII (A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV doz izleni: After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB.
Makine ısıtılır, yakıt geçişi yapılır, h: The engine is warmed up, the fuel is changed over, the air receivers are full and the telegraph test is carried out. With frequent manoeuvring, disciplined preparation is especially important.
Paralele alırken frekans/voltaj/faz eşit: When paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched; enough generators are kept on line for sudden loads such as the ramp and thrusters. The blackout test is carried out.
Yanlış faz şaft/kuplaj kırabilir; insula: Paralleling out of phase can break the shaft or the coupling; the insulation is measured.
Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug: A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is done by hand. The ullages are monitored.
Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is checked and entered in the record book.
Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; kıyı/l: Salinity is monitored with the salinometer; production is stopped near the coast and in port because of contamination. The water is disinfected.
Fanlar belirlenen hava değişim oranını s: The fans run at a capacity that gives the required rate of air changes: full capacity during vehicle handling and the required rate at sea. A fan failure is signalled by an alarm.
Yetersiz ventilasyon CO birikimi ve yakı: Insufficient ventilation creates a risk of CO build-up and of an explosion from fuel vapour; the system is kept in continuous working order.
Trim/heeling pompası ile ballast hızlı t: Ballast is transferred quickly with the anti-heeling/trim pump and the list and trim are brought to the target. Pump seals and bearings are maintained according to the PMS.
Yük planının başlangıç noktası charter p: The starting point of the cargo plan is the charter party terms and the cargo nomination. The nomination states the number of parcels, the quantity of each parcel (bbl/MT), its API gravity or density, its temperature requirements and the order of the loading and discharge ports. The Chief Officer compares this information with the tank capacity tables (sounding/ullage tables) to work out which parcel will fit into which group of tanks.
Multi-grade (çoklu parsel) yüklerde her: With multi-grade cargoes, each parcel must be carried in its own cargo system (pumps, lines, set of valves) and segregated so that commingling is prevented. The use of the slop tanks and intermediate tanks affects the integrity of the plan.
Tanklar asla %100 doldurulmaz; ısınma ka: Tanks are never filled to 100%; an allowance is left for thermal expansion. Typically a 98% filling is aimed for, and the expansion is calculated from the type of cargo, the loading temperature and the temperature rise expected during the voyage. Overfilling creates a risk of overflow and of a MARPOL violation.
Yük planının her ara aşaması (her tank d: Every intermediate stage of the cargo plan (each step in filling the tanks) is simulated in the loading computer. At each step the shear force (SF), bending moment (BM), trim, drafts (FP/AP/midships), GM and list are checked. The values are kept below the harbour and seagoing limits; above 85% is the alarm band and a sign that the plan needs revising.
Slack (yarı dolu) tanklar serbest yüzey: Slack (partly filled) tanks reduce GM through the free surface effect (FSC). The plan is built to keep the number of slack tanks as low as possible and not to leave several tanks slack at the same time.
Final kondisyon yalnız intact değil, MAR: The final condition must meet not only the intact stability criteria but also the damage stability criteria of MARPOL Annex I Reg. 28. Side and bottom damage scenarios are checked with the damage case module of the loading computer. The printouts are kept; they may be asked for in PSC and SIRE inspections.
Yükleme üç aşamada planlanır: initial (d: Loading is planned in three stages: initial (low rate, filling the lines and controlling static electricity), bulk (full rate up to the terminal limit) and topping-up (reduced rate as the final ullage approaches). The topping-up sequence defines which tank will be closed last and how the final ullage will be taken.
Boşaltma planı; pompa line-up'ını, termi: The discharge plan covers the pump line-up, the terminal rate limit, stripping of the tanks without any MARPOL violation and measurement of the ROB (remaining on board). At the end of discharge the tank bottoms are stripped and the lines drained with the eductor or stripping pump.
Plan, terminal temsilcisi ile pre-transf: The plan is reviewed jointly with the terminal representative at the pre-transfer meeting; rate limits, the ESD procedure, communication channels and emergency stop criteria are agreed. The Master gives the final approval and all cargo officers are briefed on the plan. Everyone who attends the briefing signs.
Operasyon sırasında parsel değişikliği,: If there is a change of parcel, a rate restriction or a suspicion of contamination during the operation, the plan is revised, the loading computer is run again and the revised plan is approved again. Every revision is recorded with the date and time.
Onaylı cargo plan, loadicator çıktıları,: The approved cargo plan, loading computer printouts, ullage reports and change records are filed. These records are evidence for internal audits as well as for SIRE, CDI and PSC inspections.
İyi bir yük planı sadece \"ne kadar yükl: A good cargo plan shows not only how much will be loaded but what is happening to the ship at every moment; checking the intermediate stages is therefore more critical than the final condition.
Bağlantıdan önce manifold flanşları, con: Before connection, the manifold flanges, gaskets, bolts and drip tray are inspected visually. The correct manifold is selected for the parcel to be handled; unused manifolds are closed with blank (blind) flanges with the full number of bolts. Spill containment (drip trays) and scupper plugs must be in place.
Hortumlar kargo cinsine ve basınca uygun: Hoses must be suitable for the cargo and the pressure, certified and within their test date. If a loading arm (Chiksan) is used, it is verified that it stays within its operating envelope and that its drift and limit alarms work.
Manifold bolt'ları yıldız (çapraz) sıray: The manifold bolts are tightened in a star (cross) pattern with the torque increased in stages; tightening on one side crushes the gasket and causes a leak. All bolt holes must be filled; no connection is made with bolts missing.
Gemi-kıyı arasında potansiyel farkı ve s: To prevent a potential difference and static sparks between ship and shore, the use of a bonding cable and/or an insulating flange is arranged in accordance with ISGOTT. Most modern terminals prefer an insulating flange; a wrongly applied bonding cable can cause problems with cathodic protection currents.
Bağlantı, transfere başlamadan önce çalı: Before the transfer starts, the connection is tested above the working pressure (typically 1.1 × MAWP) and all flanges are watched for leaks. If there is a leak, the pressure is released and the gasket or bolts are put right.
Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link ve dry-bre: The Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link and the dry-break (emergency release) coupling are checked, and it is verified that the line will separate safely and without spillage in an emergency release. The ESD activation time must be within the maker's specification.
Manifold, tanker güvenliğinin en yoğun r: The manifold is the point of highest risk for tanker safety; what matters here is not speed but verifying every flange one by one.
SIRE 2.0; sabit soru setinden, gemiye/du: SIRE 2.0 has moved from a fixed set of questions to a dynamic set specific to the ship and the situation, with the inspector reporting in real time on a tablet. The hardware, process and human (behaviour) dimensions are assessed separately.
VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) v: The VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) and HVPQ are kept up to date; a self-assessment is made against the SIRE 2.0 chapters. Previous PSC and SIRE findings must have been closed out with evidence.
Crew matrix, eğitim kayıtları, sertifika: The crew matrix, training records, certificates and evidence of familiarisation are prepared. Deck and manifold cleanliness, labelling, SOPEP equipment and safety equipment are checked.
CDI; kargo uyumluluğu, coating dayanımı,: A CDI inspection focuses on cargo compatibility, coating resistance, segregation and chemical safety procedures. The IBC Code and the ship-specific P&A Manual are the reference documents.
CDI questionnaire güncel tutulur; P&A Ma: The CDI questionnaire is kept up to date; the P&A Manual, coating list and compatibility tables must be accessible. The records of the last three cargoes and of tank cleaning are checked.
SBT, kargo tanklarından tamamen ayrıdır: Segregated ballast tanks are completely separate from the cargo tanks and never mix with cargo. Ballast is discharged during loading and taken on during discharge; each step is checked in the loading computer for SF/BM/GM.
Ballast alımı/değişimi BWTS aktif şekild: Ballast is taken on or exchanged with the BWTS in operation, in compliance with the D-2 standard; the operation is recorded in the Ballast Water Record Book (BWRB).
Yarı dolu (slack) tanklar serbest yüzey: Slack tanks cause a virtual loss of GM through the free surface effect. Several slack tanks at the same time can cause a critical loss of GM; the plan therefore limits the number of slack tanks.
MARPOL Reg. 28 kapsamında yan/dip yarala: Side and bottom damage scenarios under MARPOL Reg. 28 are checked with the damage module of the loading computer; the final condition must meet both the intact and the damage criteria.
ESD link, gemi ve terminalin acil durdur: The ESD link allows the ship and the terminal to share emergency stop signals; on activation the pumps stop and the valves close in a safe sequence. Because rapid closure can cause a pressure surge, the closing time must be within the maker's specification.
Transfer öncesi ESD aktivasyonu test edi: ESD activation is tested before the transfer, verifying that the system stops the pumps and closes the valves in the correct order. The result is entered in the ESD test log.
SSSCL, \"ben doldurdum\" değil \"birlikt: The SSSCL works on the principle of "we verified it together", not "I filled it in". Each item is checked physically and marked with the codes A (agreement), P (permission) and R (re-check).
Bir madde sağlanamıyorsa transfere başla: If an item cannot be met, the transfer is not started, or a transfer already under way is stopped. An incomplete or wrongly completed checklist is both a safety risk and a reason for PSC detention.
ENC kataloğu güncellenir (NtM, T&P), saf: The ENC catalogue is updated (NtM, T&P), and the safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set from the ship's draft plus the UKC. With check route, warnings for no-go areas, shoals and prohibited areas are assessed one by one.
Seyir boyunca XTD (cross-track distance): XTD (cross-track distance), wheel-over points and UKC are monitored throughout the passage, and deviations are corrected early. The plan is approved by the Master.
Kargo/balast operasyonları ilgili kodlar: Cargo and ballast operations are entered on time and in full with the relevant operation codes. Each page is signed by the officer in charge and by the Master; the records are kept on board for at least three years.
ORB I ile fiili operasyon arasındaki tut: A discrepancy between ORB entries and the actual operation leads to heavy penalties. PSC and coastal states compare the records with physical evidence (soundings, tank condition).
STS operasyonu onaylı bir STS plan ve ri: An STS operation is carried out under an approved STS plan and risk assessment. The POAC takes on overall advisory control; the Masters of the two ships keep responsibility for their own ships. Weather and sea limits and abort criteria are defined in advance.
Yokohama fender'lar ve mooring pattern,: Yokohama fenders and the mooring pattern keep the two ships at a safe distance. The approach manoeuvre is made slowly and under control. A leak test is carried out after the hoses are connected.
Transfer süresince her iki gemide rate,: Throughout the transfer, rate, pressure, mooring line tension and the weather are monitored on both ships; if an abort criterion is exceeded, the transfer is stopped safely with the ESD.
Pilot geldiğinde Master ile manevra plan: When the pilot boards, the manoeuvring plan (number of tugs, approach angle, speed, mooring order, manifold target) is shared with the Master. Tug lines are made fast securely through the Panama chocks and on the bitts.
Mooring head/breast/spring sırasıyla ver: The mooring lines are sent out in the order head, breast and spring lines. Line tension and snap-back zones are managed in accordance with MEG4; no one stands in a snap-back zone.
Closed gauging'de tank atmosferi dışarı: In closed gauging, measurements are taken without opening the tank atmosphere, with a permanently installed system (CTS – Closed Tape System, CPAS – Cargo Pressure/level Automation System, or a radar level gauge). In restricted gauging, measurements are taken through a small opening via a vapour-lock valve. Open gauging (ullage hatch fully open) is prohibited because of toxic and flammable vapours.
Otomatik sistem (radar/CPAS) ile manuel: Readings from the automatic system (radar/CPAS) are compared periodically with manual (CTS) readings; if they differ, the calibration of the system is questioned. Custody transfer measurements are usually taken together with the shore surveyor.
Ölçülen ullage, geminin trim ve list değ: The measured ullage is corrected for the ship's trim and list with the trim correction in the tank calibration tables. The corrected ullage gives the gross observed volume (GOV) from the ullage table.
GOV, ortalama sıcaklık ve density ile AS: Using the average temperature and density and the ASTM/API tables (e.g. 54B/6B), the GOV is converted to gross standard volume (GSV) and to weight (in vacuum/in air). This value is the basis of the B/L and the cargo measurement report.
Manuel ölçümde dahi vapour'a maruz kalma: Even manual gauging carries a risk of exposure to vapour; the correct PPE (gas detector, suitable respiratory protection where needed) and standing upwind are essential. Additional precautions are taken with cargoes containing H2S.
Sertifikalı pilot ladder, manrope, stanc: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, stanchions, a lifebuoy and lighting; if required, a combination ladder (accommodation ladder + pilot ladder) is arranged. The rigging is done under the supervision of the responsible officer and checked against a checklist.
Kötü bakımlı basamak, yanlış sabitleme v: A poorly maintained step, wrong securing or missing lighting can kill. A crew member stands by when the pilot embarks and disembarks.
VR return line, vapour coupling ile bağl: The vapour return line is connected with a vapour coupling, bonding is provided and a flame arrester is fitted in the line. The flame arrester prevents a flashback from shore to ship.
Vapour line patlayıcı karışım taşır; fla: The vapour line carries a flammable mixture; the flame arrester and pressure management are critical. The rate must not exceed the capacity of the vapour return line.
Sıvının türbülanslı akışı, serbest düşüş: Turbulent flow of the liquid, free fall, water droplets and filters generate static charge. Working at a low rate, especially in the first minutes of loading, limits the build-up.
Statik biriktiren kargolarda ölçüm/örnek: With static accumulator cargoes, the specified waiting (settling) times are observed before gauging or sampling; bonding is checked before metal equipment is lowered into a tank.
Smoke ve heat dedektörleri ile sample ex: Smoke and heat detectors and the sample extraction (cargo hold) systems are tested periodically; it is verified that the correct zone is shown on the alarm panel.
Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar personeli duy: Repeated false alarms make people insensitive to alarms; the root cause (dust, humidity, sensor age) is analysed and eliminated.
P/V valf setpoint'i (yay gerginliği) per: The P/V valve set points (spring tension) are tested periodically and the flame screens are cleaned. A P/V valve stuck closed leads to a tank rupture when pressure builds up.
IGS otomatik basınç kontrolü kalibre edi: The automatic pressure control of the IGS is calibrated; the tanks are always kept at positive pressure. A sensor or actuator failure must be signalled by an alarm.
Transfer öncesi scupper'lar tıkanır (plu: Before the transfer, the scuppers are plugged and drip trays are placed so that any spill on deck cannot reach the sea. No transfer takes place without the plugs in.
Coating hasarları onarılır; katodik koru: Coating damage is repaired and cathodic protection measurements are taken. Corrosion threatens structural integrity over time.
Yıldırım radarı ve hava raporları izleni: The lightning radar and weather reports are monitored; if lightning comes within the specified distance (e.g. less than 5 NM), the transfer is stopped. Strong wind gusts are assessed for their effect on mooring line and hose tension.
Transfer durdurma kararı terminal ile ko: The decision to stop the transfer is taken in coordination with the terminal; lightning is the highest risk while venting is under way and the manifold is open.
Yangın (cargo deck dahil), SOPEP/spill v: Fire (including on the cargo deck), SOPEP/spill and man overboard drills are held at the required intervals; the scenarios are realistic and specific to the ship. After each drill a debrief is held and improvement notes are recorded.
SOPEP ekipmanı (absorbentler, scupper pl: The SOPEP equipment (absorbents, scupper plugs, shovels, drums and so on) is kept quickly accessible; the notification list (coastal state, company) must be up to date.
Geminin ölçümünden (ship figure) elde ed: The quantity obtained from the ship's measurement (ship figure) is compared with the shore measurement (shore figure). If the difference exceeds the specified tolerance (e.g. 0.5%), a Letter of Protest is issued; otherwise the defence against later cargo claims is weakened.
B/L Master/yetkili tarafından imzalanır;: The B/L is signed by the Master or an authorised person; a clean B/L is not signed until the quantity, description and condition have been verified. A wrong or unsigned B/L has serious commercial and legal consequences.
Kâğıt haritalarda düzeltmeler standart y: Corrections to paper charts are made by the standard method (in violet ink); ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P (temporary and preliminary) notices are also followed.
Chart correction log, harita güncelliğin: The chart correction log is the proof that the charts are up to date; PSC may ask for this record and for the number of the last NtM applied.
Tank içi sıcaklık homojen değildir; özel: The temperature in a tank is not uniform; with heated cargoes in particular there is a vertical gradient. Readings are therefore taken at the top, middle and bottom and a weighted average is calculated. A closed-system portable electronic thermometer (MMC type) is preferred.
Density numune üzerinden hidrometre (are: The density is determined from a sample with a hydrometer or by laboratory methods; often the shore certificate of quality is used as the reference. The temperature at which it was measured is recorded, because density depends on temperature.
Gross observed volume (GOV), ortalama sı: Using the gross observed volume (GOV), the average temperature and the standard density, the gross standard volume (GSV) is obtained with ASTM Table 54B and converted to weight (MT in vacuum/in air) with the WCF (weight correction factor).
Sıcak kargolarda (fuel oil, asfalt) ölçü: With hot cargoes (fuel oil, asphalt) there is a risk of splashes and burns during gauging; suitable PPE is essential. The results are entered in the cargo measurement report.
Yanma için yakıt (HC buharı), oksijen ve: Combustion needs fuel (hydrocarbon vapour), oxygen and a source of ignition. The IGS removes one side of the triangle by bringing the oxygen below the critical level. With O2 below 8%, a hydrocarbon/air mixture cannot explode; in practice 5% is aimed for to leave a safety margin.
Flue gas; scrubber'da soğutulur ve SOx/p: The flue gas is cooled in the scrubber and cleaned of SOx and particulates. The deck water seal is the critical barrier that prevents gas from flowing back from the cargo tanks to the engine room; its water level is monitored continuously. If the deck seal runs dry, there is a risk of backflow and explosion.
IGS startup; scrubber su akışı, deck sea: The IGS is started up with a checklist covering scrubber water flow, deck seal level, O2 analyser calibration and starting the blowers. Before inert gas is delivered to the tanks, the outlet O2 value (below 5%) is verified.
Boşaltma sırasında tank seviyesi düştükç: During discharge, inert gas takes the place of the cargo as the tank level falls; the tank is kept at positive pressure (typically around +200 mmWG). Negative pressure can let outside air in and cause the tank to implode.
P/V (pressure/vacuum) valfleri tankı aşı: P/V (pressure/vacuum) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum; their flame screens are kept clean. The low pressure, high O2 and deck seal alarms must be active and tested.
IGS arızası kargo operasyonunu durdurma: An IGS failure is a reason to stop cargo operations; no loading or discharge takes place unless the system is working safely.
COW; clingage (duvara yapışan yağ) mikta: COW increases the outturn (quantity discharged) by reducing clingage (oil sticking to the tank walls), and reduces the need for water washing and therefore the amount of slops. MARPOL makes COW mandatory for crude oil tankers above a certain tonnage.
COW yalnız tank O2'si %8'in altında iken: COW is carried out only while the tank O2 is below 8%. COW with high O2 can lead to an explosion caused by a static spark.
COW Manual'a göre tank washing makineler: According to the COW Manual, a single-stage or multi-stage washing pattern is chosen for the tank washing machines; the machine angles (top/bottom wash) and times are set for each tank. The bottom wash directs the sediment on the tank bottom towards the stripping suction.
Yıkama, boşaltmanın uygun aşamasında baş: Washing is started at the appropriate stage of the discharge; records are kept for each tank before, during and after washing. The hydrocarbon and oxygen levels and the line pressure are monitored. As crude oil is used instead of washing water, the tank bottom is drained continuously by stripping.
Makinelerin döndüğü (rotasyon kontrolü): It is verified that the machines are rotating (rotation check) and that the nozzles are not blocked; low pressure or a machine that does not rotate prevents effective washing.
COW, doğru yapıldığında çevresel ve tica: Done correctly, COW brings environmental and commercial gains; but an inert atmosphere is a precondition without exception.
İlk akış düşük rate ile başlatılır; hatl: Initial flow is started at a low rate; it is verified that the lines lead to the correct tank, that there are no leaks and that the build-up of static electricity stays limited. The first 30 minutes or so at low rate are critical for static electricity.
Hat doğrulandıktan sonra terminal limiti: Once the line-up is confirmed, the rate is increased to the bulk rate, up to the terminal limit; the IGS positive pressure is maintained. When a tank is 90% full, the rate is reduced to the topping-up rate and the final ullage is followed by manual/closed gauging.
Yükleme sırasında yer değiştiren tank at: The tank atmosphere displaced during loading is released through the venting or vapour return system; the rate must not exceed the venting capacity, otherwise overpressure develops and the P/V valves are strained.
Yükleme sonunda hatlar son tanka veya te: At the end of loading the lines are cleared towards the last tank or the terminal (line clearing); cargo left in the lines can cause contamination in the next operation.
Boşaltmadan önce pompa-hat-valf hattı (l: Before discharge the pump, line and valve line-up is verified; a wrong valve position causes contamination or a pressure surge. The pumps are primed to remove air and prevent cavitation.
Discharge rate terminal kabul limitini a: The discharge rate does not exceed the terminal's acceptance limit. As the tank level falls, the pump suction conditions become more difficult; cavitation (vapour bubbles caused by vacuum) destroys the pump. The rate is therefore reduced in the final stage and stripping is started.
Eductor veya stripper pompası ile tank d: The tank bottoms and lines are swept a final time with the eductor or stripping pump. At the end of discharge, the quantity remaining in each tank (ROB) is measured and reported; a high ROB means a commercial loss and is a reason for cargo claims.
Inert (oksijensiz, HC'li) bir tank doğru: If an inerted tank (no oxygen, containing hydrocarbons) is ventilated directly with air, the hydrocarbon concentration passes through the flammable range (the critical dilution line) on its way from rich to lean, and because oxygen is also entering, a flammable atmosphere forms. To prevent this, the tank is first purged with inert gas until the hydrocarbon content is well below the flammable limit (e.g. less than 2% by volume); only then is air introduced.
Purge aşamasında inert gaz ile HC seyrel: In the purging stage the hydrocarbons are diluted with inert gas; then, by ventilating with air, the O2 is brought up to 21% and the hydrocarbons down below the LFL (1% LFL). At every stage gas is measured continuously at several points (O2, HC/LEL, and H2S and benzene where needed).
Gas free certificate alınmadan tanka gir: No one enters a tank without a gas-free certificate. The enclosed space entry permit includes continuous gas monitoring, a standby person, communications, a rescue plan and continued ventilation. Enclosed space entry and rescue drills are held regularly under SOLAS III/19.
Tank yıkama suları ve COW kalıntıları sl: Tank washings and COW residues are collected in the slop tank, where oil and water separate over time (settling). The slop level and the oil/water interface are followed.
Mümkün olduğunda slop'taki yağ fazı, bir: Where possible, the oil phase of the slops is recovered by loading the next cargo on top of it (load-on-top); this gives both environmental and commercial advantages.
Geri kazanılamayan slop yalnız liman atı: Slops that cannot be recovered are delivered only to a port reception facility. The transfer is recorded in the Oil Record Book with the appropriate code (Code J, etc.) and the receipt is kept.
Mechanical seal ve bearing PMS aralıklar: Mechanical seals and bearings are replaced at the PMS intervals; impellers are inspected for wear and erosion. Vibration analysis is used to detect failures early.
Kapasite testi, discharge sırasında rate: A capacity test is carried out by measuring the rate during discharge; falling performance points to seal or impeller wear. A high rate at a low level causes cavitation.
Hidrolik yağ analiz edilir; seal sızıntı: The hydraulic oil is analysed and seal leakage (cofferdam drain) is monitored, because hydraulic oil getting into the cargo causes contamination. The motor insulation is measured periodically.
Cofferdam drain'de hidrolik yağ tespiti: Hydraulic oil found at the cofferdam drain is an early sign of seal failure; ignoring it leads to cargo claims.
Jacket water sıcaklığı yeterli olduğunda: The evaporator is started when the jacket water temperature is high enough (e.g. above 50°C); salinity is monitored with the salinometer (e.g. below 10 ppm). Production is stopped in port and near the coast because of contamination.
Potable su için dezenfeksiyon (klorlama/: Potable water is disinfected (chlorination/UV) and mineralised; periodic bacteriological tests are carried out.
OWS çıkışı OCM ile izlenir; 15 ppm aşılı: The OWS discharge is monitored by the OCM; if 15 ppm is exceeded, the automatic three-way valve returns the bilge water to the tank. Discharge takes place only with the ship en route and under the MARPOL conditions (it is prohibited in the Antarctic area).
OWS'i bypass eden herhangi bir düzenek (: If any arrangement that bypasses the OWS (a magic pipe) is found, heavy fines and imprisonment follow; the ORB Part I entries must agree with what actually happened.
Piston, liner, yatak ve fuel injection e: Pistons, liners, bearings and fuel injection equipment are overhauled according to running hours; clearance and wear measurements are recorded. Cleaning and balancing the turbocharger maintains performance.
Aşırı ısınan yatak yağ buharı (oil mist): An overheated bearing produces oil mist; the oil mist detector and the crankcase relief valves protect against an explosion. Opening the crankcase after a hot bearing carries a risk of fire or explosion.
DG'ler paralele alınırken frekans, volta: When generators are paralleled, frequency, voltage and phase sequence are matched; faulty synchronisation causes mechanical damage through a sudden torque. Load sharing must be balanced.
Black-out recovery testi periyodik yapıl: The blackout recovery test is carried out periodically and the insulation resistance is measured. Automatic standby start and preferential tripping must work correctly.
Her operasyon ilgili kodla işlenir; giri: Each operation is entered with the relevant code; entries are made on time and every page is signed by the Master. The entries must agree with the actual situation (soundings, tank contents).
PSC, ORB ile fiziksel kanıtı karşılaştır: PSC compares the ORB with the physical evidence; a discrepancy is a reason for detention and prosecution.
Sludge tank sounding düzenli alınır; ber: Sludge tank soundings are taken regularly; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to a shore reception facility. The incinerator flame failure trip must work properly.
Incinerator çalışırken flame failure tri: While the incinerator is running, the flame failure trip and the emission limits (MARPOL Annex VI) are monitored.
Purifier disc'leri belirli çalışma saati: The purifier discs are cleaned at set running hours; automatic back-flushing and ΔP are monitored on the filters. Working with hot HFO carries a risk of splashes and burns.
Sıcak HFO açığa çıkarsa ciddi yanık yapa: Hot HFO released into the open causes serious burns; isolation and PPE are provided before maintenance.
Nitrit/pH/kloride değerleri haftalık tes: Nitrite, pH and chloride values are tested weekly; the correct inhibitor dosage prevents corrosion. Cleaning the coolers keeps the heat transfer efficient.
Bakımda CIP kimyasalları kullanılırsa SD: If CIP chemicals are used during maintenance, PPE according to the SDS is essential.
Limandan ayrılmadan önce (12 saat içinde: The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); the emergency steering and its communications are verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil (ISO 4406) is monitored.
Yüksek basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt alt: A high-pressure hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the pressure is released before maintenance.
CO2/foam sistemi yıllık ve 5 yıllık test: The CO2 and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; portable equipment, quick-closing valves, fire dampers and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release the space is evacuated and the lock-out is applied.
CO2 deşarjı boğulma riski taşır; release: A CO2 release can suffocate; it is made only after the space has been completely evacuated and a head count taken. The lock-out system prevents an accidental release.
Scrubber temizliği, deck seal su seviyes: Scrubber cleaning, the deck seal water level and O2 analyser calibration are dealt with regularly. Blower bearings and vibration are monitored.
IGS düzgün çalışmadan kargo operasyonu y: No cargo operation can take place unless the IGS is working properly; the maintenance plan is coordinated with the cargo programme.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO (total residu: After the pre-flow test, the TRO (total residual oxidant) level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting. The operation is recorded in the BWRB.
Electrochlorination ünitelerinde açığa ç: In electrochlorination units, the hydrogen released creates a flammable atmosphere if there is no proper ventilation; venting and gas monitoring are critical.
Scrubber'lı gemilerde wash water pH/PAH/: On ships with scrubbers, the pH, PAH and turbidity of the wash water are monitored; ships without scrubbers use compliant fuel (e.g. 0.5% sulphur). In areas where open-loop operation is restricted, the appropriate mode is selected.
CII rating (A-E) yıllık hesaplanır; SEEM: The CII rating (A–E) is calculated annually and the SEEMP Part III improvement plan is followed. A D or E rating requires a corrective plan.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; kritik e: A monthly overdue report is produced; overdue jobs on critical equipment are closed out at once or justified. Maintenance records (hours, parts, measurements) are kept complete.
Kritik ekipman overdue'ları ISM uygunsuz: Overdue jobs on critical equipment create an ISM non-conformity (NC); class surveys rely on the PMS records.
Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out regularly; the air receivers are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a risk of fire and explosion.
Basınçlı hava cilde enjekte olabilir; ba: Compressed air can be injected into the skin; during maintenance the system is depressurised and isolated.
Sensörler periyodik kalibre edilir; alar: Sensors are calibrated periodically; alarm points and the dead-man alarm are tested. In UMS mode the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins is verified.
Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar gerçek alarmı: Repeated false alarms lead to a real alarm being missed; the root cause is eliminated and any alarm suppression is recorded.
Kazan suyu testleri (pH, kloride, fosfat: Boiler water tests (pH, chloride, phosphate and so on) are carried out regularly; deposits are removed by daily blow-down. Soot blowing prevents soot build-up.
Kurum birikimi soot fire riski yaratır;: Soot build-up creates a risk of a soot fire; the safety valve test is the last protection against overpressure.
Seal ve bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; ka: Seals and bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified with a capacity test. The line segregation is maintained so that the segregated ballast never mixes with oil.
SBT kontaminasyonu ağır MARPOL ihlalidir: Contamination of segregated ballast is a serious MARPOL violation; the line segregation is maintained carefully during maintenance.
Recip stripper'da valve clearance ayarla: On reciprocating strippers the valve clearances are adjusted; on eductors the nozzles are checked for wear. A worn nozzle reduces the suction efficiency.
İyi stripping düşük ROB demektir; bu hem: Good stripping means a low ROB, which is both a commercial and an environmental gain.
CIP (cleaning in place) periyodik yapılı: CIP (cleaning in place) is carried out periodically; on plate heat exchangers the plates are inspected for wear and cracks. Suitable PPE is essential for CIP chemicals.
CIP kimyasalları aşındırıcıdır; SDS'e gö: CIP chemicals are corrosive; PPE and ventilation are provided according to the SDS.
Viscometer periyodik kalibre edilir ve f: The viscometer is calibrated periodically and its filter cleaned; the viscosity control loop is verified together with the fuel heater.
Yanlış viskozite enjektör/pompa hasarı y: Wrong viscosity damages the injectors and fuel pumps; calibration is never neglected.
Heating coil sızıntı testi yapılır (karg: The heating coils are leak-tested (water or steam leaking into the cargo causes contamination). The heat-up rate is controlled according to the cargo instructions and the temperature is kept within the target range.
Aşırı ısıtma kargonun flashpoint'ine yak: Overheating brings the cargo close to its flashpoint and degrades it; the upper temperature limit is monitored.
Operasyon öncesi pre-bunker toplantısı y: Before the operation a pre-bunkering meeting is held; the tank sequence, rate and emergency stop are agreed. Pumping starts slowly and topping-up is controlled by hand. Scupper plugs and bonding are in place.
MARPOL numunesi mühürlü olarak alınır ve: The MARPOL sample is taken sealed and kept for the specified period (e.g. 12 months). The contents of the BDN are verified and entered in ORB Part I with the appropriate code (Code H).
Yolcular boarding pass ve ISPS güvenlik: Passengers pass through boarding pass checks and ISPS security screening and are entered in the manifest. Boarding and disembarking flows are organised with gangway safety and crowd management in mind.
Gemideki yolcu/personel sayısı her zaman: The number of passengers and crew on board must always be current and correct; in an emergency the manifest is the basis of search and rescue (passengers with special needs are flagged).
Brifing; alarm sinyalleri, muster statio: The safety briefing covers the alarm signals, the muster station, how to put on a lifejacket and the escape route; it is reinforced on the cabin TV and through public announcements and videos. It is given shortly after departure.
Yolcular acil durumda ilk kez öğrenmemel: Passengers should not be learning this for the first time in an emergency; the briefing must be early and easy to understand.
IS Code yolcu gemileri için passenger cr: For passenger ships, the IS Code contains heeling moment criteria for passenger crowding (passengers gathering on one side) and for turning. The weight of passengers and their luggage is taken into account on standard assumptions.
Yolcu gemilerinde stabilite kriterleri e: On passenger ships the stability criteria are stricter because of the additional crowding and turning moments.
Lifeboat/davit, life raft (servis tarihi: Lifeboats and davits, liferafts (service dates), lifejackets and the MES are subject to periodic testing and maintenance; release gear is maintained following the maker's procedure. It is verified that the capacity is sufficient for the number of passengers.
Yolcu gemisinde LSA eksikliği toplu can: On a passenger ship, a shortfall in LSA means a risk of mass loss of life; maintenance allows no compromise.
Smoke/heat dedektörleri, sprinkler ve A-: Smoke and heat detectors, sprinklers and A-class boundary and fire door systems are tested; the zone display on the alarm panel is verified. Coverage must be complete in the passenger spaces.
Yolcu gemisi yangınında erken algılama v: In a passenger ship fire, early detection and subdivision prevent mass casualties.
PRM yolcular embarkation'da işaretlenir;: Passengers with reduced mobility (PRM) are flagged at embarkation; an assigned crew member, an evacuation chair and a refuge area are planned for each of them. As the lifts cannot be used, evacuation by the stairs is practised.
PRM tahliyesi önceden planlanmazsa genel: If the evacuation of PRM passengers is not planned in advance, it also slows down the general evacuation.
Yolcu/bagaj X-ray ve metal detektör ile: Passengers and luggage are screened by X-ray and metal detectors; unauthorised entry is prevented at access control points. Measures are increased according to the security level.
Ağır hava beklentisinde açık güverteler/: When heavy weather is expected, open decks and pools are closed and outdoor activities are stopped. Passengers are warned by announcement and loose items are secured.
Yolcu alanları, kaymaz yüzey ve korkuluk: Passenger areas are maintained with attention to non-slip surfaces and the safety of railings; wet floors are marked. Paint and corrosion maintenance is carried out regularly.
Radar/ECDIS/AIS fonksiyon testleri ve ka: Radar, ECDIS and AIS function tests and calibration are carried out; the sensor inputs (gyro, GPS, log) are verified. The back-up equipment is kept in working order.
DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S: DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically. Battery and HRU expiry dates are followed.
Yolcular alarm sonrası muster station'a: After the alarm, passengers are directed to their muster stations, where the lifejacket and the procedure are demonstrated. Attendance is verified by counting and marking. If possible, this is done before departure.
Costa Concordia'da (2012) muster drill h: On the Costa Concordia (2012) the accident happened before the muster drill had been held; holding the drill early is therefore a critical lesson learned.
Operasyon öncesi alan gevşek eşyalardan: Before the operation the area is cleared of loose items; the fire team and the FFA (foam) are kept ready. The wind (relative wind) and communications are coordinated with the pilot.
Embarkation/debarkation ile manifest ger: The manifest is updated in real time with embarkation and disembarkation; PRM and special needs are flagged. Consistency with the authorised copy ashore is ensured.
Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA, evacuatio: Certificates must be valid; LSA and FFA, the evacuation arrangements, sanitation and previous findings are checked. Passenger ship inspections are comprehensive.
Acil durum ve yolcu yönlendirme görevler: Emergency and passenger guidance duties are assigned for every voyage; they are updated when crew or cruise staff change and familiarisation is carried out.
MES, lifeboat ve life raft koordineli ku: The MES, lifeboats and liferafts are used in a coordinated way; passenger guidance, mustering and counting are practised. The evacuation time and bottlenecks are assessed.
Tahliye darboğazları (dar koridor, asans: Evacuation bottlenecks (narrow corridors, lifts) must be identified in advance and removed.
Pre-arrival güvenlik bilgisi PFSO ile pa: Pre-arrival security information is shared with the PFSO; when the security levels differ or in special circumstances, a Declaration of Security is completed. Access control is coordinated.
Gemi revin ile ilk müdahale yapılır; ger: First aid is given in the ship's hospital; if necessary, TMAS (telemedical advice) is obtained and a medevac (by helicopter or tender) is planned. The transfer of the patient is coordinated safely.
Etkinlik alanlarında kapasite ve çıkış y: In event areas, the capacity and clear escape routes are managed; the staff are trained in crowd management. In an emergency the guidance procedure is applied.
Galley, kabin, public space ve makine da: Fire scenarios in the galley, cabins, public spaces and engine room are practised; fire team response, closing of fire doors, sprinklers and passenger guidance are drilled.
Yolcu gemisinde yangının yayılması paniğ: On a passenger ship, the spread of a fire can lead to panic and mass casualties; subdivision and a fast response are essential.
MOB alarmında pozisyon işaretlenir; Will: On a man overboard alarm, the position is marked, a Williamson, Anderson or Scharnow turn is made and the rescue boat is prepared. Lookouts and communications are coordinated.
Lifeboat ve life raft indirme/launch, mu: Lowering and launching of lifeboats and liferafts, mustering and passenger guidance are drilled; the davits, brakes and release gear are tested. The evacuation time is followed.
Lifeboat drill'lerinde on-load release g: Accidents involving on-load release gear during lifeboat drills have caused deaths in the past; attention is paid to the maker's procedure and to the use of fall preventer devices.
Tender embarkation platformu/gangway güv: The tender embarkation platform and gangway are rigged safely; if the weather or sea limits are exceeded, the operation is stopped. Passengers are counted on every tender and lifejackets are provided.
Tender iniş-binme, özellikle yaşlı/PRM y: Getting on and off tenders is the point where injuries happen most often, especially for elderly and PRM passengers.
ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri ay: The ENCs are updated and the safety settings adjusted. A deviation from the approved plan (for example a sail-past close to the shore) is made only after a risk assessment and with the Master's approval.
Costa Concordia, onaylı rotadan plansız: The Costa Concordia showed that an unplanned deviation from the approved route can lead to disaster; deviations must be controlled and documented.
Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting; where required, the combination ladder is set at the correct angle. The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.
Tug, bow/stern thruster ve (varsa) azipo: The ship manoeuvres with tugs, bow and stern thrusters and (if fitted) azipods; the large lateral area of a cruise ship is critical in wind. Mooring is managed safely.
FWG ve RO birlikte çalıştırılarak yüksek: The FWG and the RO plant are run together to meet the high demand; salinity and conductivity are monitored, and production is stopped near the coast and in port. The water is disinfected (chlorine/UV) and mineralised.
On a passenger ship water quality is monitored closely because of the risk of a waterborne outbreak (e.g. Legionella).
STP biyolojik/kimyasal arıtma ile çıkış: The STP brings the effluent up to the required standards by biological and chemical treatment; discharge complies with the distance and area rules. Discharge is restricted in special areas.
Yetersiz arıtmayla deşarj çevre ihlali v: Discharge with insufficient treatment is an environmental violation and a public health risk.
CO2/foam/water-mist yıllık/5 yıllık test: CO2, foam and water-mist systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release, the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
Scrubber wash water izlenir veya uyumlu: The scrubber wash water is monitored, or compliant fuel is used; ECA and port rules are complied with. The annual CII is calculated and the SEEMP measures are applied.
Birçok cruise limanı shore power/emisyon: Many cruise ports pay particular attention to shore power and emission rules.
Chiller ve hava işleme üniteleri bakıma: Chillers and air handling units are maintained; filters are cleaned or replaced. Cooling towers and humidifiers are disinfected because of the Legionella risk.
Kötü bakımlı HVAC, hava kalitesi sorunla: Poorly maintained HVAC creates air quality problems and a risk of a Legionella outbreak; disinfection is never neglected.
Havuz suyu filtre edilir ve klor/pH süre: Pool water is filtered and its chlorine level and pH are monitored continuously; circulation and water renewal are ensured. In water parks and jacuzzis, Legionella and microbiological control are critical.
Yetersiz dezenfeksiyon gastrointestinal: Insufficient disinfection creates a risk of gastrointestinal outbreaks and Legionella; water quality is monitored continuously.
Emergency generator otomatik başlatma (b: The emergency generator is tested by automatic starting (blackout simulation), and it is verified that it supplies the critical loads within the required time. The UPS batteries and their autonomy are checked.
Acil güç, tahliye sistemlerinin (aydınla: Emergency power is vital for the evacuation systems (lighting, public address) to work.
Gangway ve shell door hidroliği, fren ve: The gangway and shell door hydraulics, brakes and locking systems are maintained; the SWL and the safety nets and railings are checked. A safe condition for passenger use is verified.
Gangway, yolcu yaralanmalarının sık yaşa: The gangway is a frequent point of passenger injuries; maintenance and safety are important.
Yüksek gerilim shore connection (HVSC),: High-voltage shore connection (HVSC) involves cable connection, earthing, phase and voltage synchronisation and load transfer; the changeover from the ship's generators to shore power is made safely and without interruption.
HVSC yüksek gerilim taşır; interlock, to: HVSC carries high voltage; interlocks, earthing and LOTO discipline are followed strictly. Emergency disconnection is kept ready.
Fin stabilizer açılma/kapanma ve hidroli: The extending and retracting of the fin stabilisers and their hydraulic system are maintained; on anti-roll tank systems, water transfer and control are verified. The fins are housed in port.
Dışarıda kalan fin, yanaşmada rıhtım/tek: A fin left extended creates a risk of collision with the quay or other craft during berthing.
Pervane (CPP ise pitch), yağlama ve seal: The propeller (pitch if a CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the propulsion motor and its insulation and the controls are tested. A function test is run before manoeuvring.
Pod seal/yatak izlenir (seal sızıntısı k: Pod seals and bearings are monitored (seal leakage is critical), the insulation and cooling of the electric motor are checked, and azimuth control and feedback are calibrated.
Pod seal arızası su girişi ve büyük onar: A pod seal failure means water ingress and a major repair; multiple pods give redundancy that supports safe manoeuvring.
Otel + propulsion yüküne göre DG sayısı: The number of generators on line is adjusted by the PMS to the hotel and propulsion load; synchronisation and balanced load sharing are ensured. The blackout recovery test is carried out.
Cruise gemisinde black-out hem propulsio: On a cruise ship a blackout affects both propulsion and the hotel load; redundancy and fast recovery are critical.
Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug: A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts slowly and topping-up is done by hand. Additional safety and communication measures are applied while passengers are on board.
OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur: Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offence with heavy penalties; the records must agree with what actually happened. Large fines have been imposed in the cruise industry in the past.
Soğutma kompresörleri ve refrigerant sis: The refrigeration compressors and the refrigerant system are maintained; store room temperatures are monitored continuously and kept on alarm. The hygiene and defrost programme is applied.
Soğuk zincir kaybı gıda kaynaklı salgın: A break in the cold chain increases the risk of food-borne outbreaks (norovirus and others).
